column2: manga e maracujá smoothie innocent
column3:
Viver no estrangeiro é uma aventura. Tudo é novidade: descobrimos novos sítios todos os dias, conhecemos gente nova, aprendemos a dançar samba (se nos tivermos mudado para o Brasil)... Depois de um tempo, começamos a sentir saudade do que ficou para trás: de uma boa bica, de um bacalhau à Brás ou dos almoços de família ao domingo. Quando conhecemos outros estrangeiros, gostamos de conversar sobre estas pequenas coisas que tanta falta nos fazem.

Pronto, nesta garrafa de smoothie de manga e maracujá, é exatamente isso que acontece. A nossa querida manga vem da Índia, enquanto o maracujá cresceu no Equador. Como resultado, e se escutar com atenção, é provável que consiga ouvir algumas histórias tradicionais hindus ou que consiga viajar até à Cordilheira dos Andes...

column2: Energía super smoothie innocent
column3:
Energia
Lembra-se da última vez que guardou o telemóvel na gaveta e se sentou no sofá a ler um livro? Foi um momento relaxante, não foi?
O corpo funciona mais ou menos assim. Sem as vitaminas necessárias, o seu corpo está muito mais sujeito ao cansaço. Por isso, criámos o nosso smoothie Energia, ideal para lhe proporcionar toda a energia de que precisa para os seus longos dias. No seu interior, você pode encontrar a melhor fruta (isso era óbvio), como morangos, cerejas e maçãs, mas também um pouco de infusão de guaraná e um pouco de beterraba. E, como realmente queríamos surpreendê-lo, enriquecemos o smoothie com vitaminas B1, B2, B6 e C, que contribuem para um metabolismo adequado, e as vitaminas B3 e C que ajudam a combater o cansaço.
Se for correr uma maratona, se for jogar futebol com os amigos ou se passar o dia em reuniões, aproveite.

Resumindo, é um smoothie, mas em versão super.

column2: Antioxidante super smoothie innocent
column3:
Para apresentar este novo smoothie, poderíamos dizer-lhe que sim, que de facto, ajuda a prevenir a oxidação. E podíamos também dizer que um elemento sofre uma oxidação quando sofre uma subtração de eletrões, o que se traduz num aumento do seu número em oxidação*. Mas como tudo isto parece um pouco complicado, preferimos jogar pelo seguro e dizer-lhe aquilo que irá encontrar nesta receita.
E isso é simples: é uma combinação refrescante de kiwi, pepino, maça, lima e sementes de linhaça. Contém três antioxidantes, vitaminas C, E e selénio, para ajudar a manter as células frescas.
O corpo é composto por milhares de milhões delas. Todas juntas resultam em... você. Sim, você com essas sardas e esse sorriso lindo. Por isso, é uma boa ideia cuidar delas. Em suma, é um smoothie, mas em versão super.

*Obrigado, Wikipedia

column2: Beyond Beef Crispy Tacos
column3:
Prep Time: 20 mins
Cook Time: 25 mins
Total Time: 45 mins
Yields: 8 tacos

Ingredients
*16 oz Beyond Ground Beef
*½ medium onion, finely chopped
*2 tbsp taco seasoning
*2 tbsp tomato paste
*¼ cup water or vegetable broth, as needed
*Salt, to taste
*8 (6-inch) taco-size flour tortillas
*2–3 cups nondairy mozzarella cheese, shredded
*Avocado or vegetable oil, for frying
*Fresh cilantro, finely chopped (for garnish)

Instructions

Cook the Filling
1. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add chopped onion and cook for 2–3 minutes, until softened.
3. Add Beyond Ground Beef and cook for 4–5 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon until mostly browned.
4. Stir in tomato paste and taco seasoning.
5. Add water (or broth) as needed to moisten, then cook 3–4 minutes until thickened and most liquid has evaporated.
6. Taste and season with salt if needed. Remove from heat and let cool slightly before assembling.

Assemble the Tacos
1. Lay out tortillas on a clean surface.
2. On the top half of each tortilla, sprinkle 1½–2 tbsp nondairy mozzarella.
3. Spoon some Beyond Beef filling over the cheese, then top with another 1½–2 tbsp cheese.
4. Fold the bottom half of the tortilla over the filling and press gently to seal.
5. Place folded tacos on a large baking sheet while you assemble the rest (makes about 8 tacos).

Fry the Tacos
1. Heat 3–4 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Working in batches, pan-fry tacos for about 1 minute per side, or until golden brown and crispy.
3. Transfer to a wire rack or paper towel–lined tray to drain excess oil.
4. Add a bit more oil between batches if needed.

Serve
1. Garnish with fresh cilantro (optional).
2. Serve immediately while hot and crispy, with your favorite dips or salsa.

Cilantro Dip 

Prep Time: 10 mins
Total Time: 10 mins
Yields: About 1 cup

Ingredients
*1 cup nondairy sour cream (or plain nondairy yogurt)
*½ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped (loosely packed)
*1 small clove garlic, minced
*1 tbsp fresh lime juice (or lemon juice)
*1 tbsp olive oil (optional, for creaminess)
*Salt & pepper, to taste
*1–2 tbsp water (to thin, if needed)

Instructions
1. In a blender or food processor, combine nondairy sour cream, cilantro, garlic, lime juice, and olive oil. Blend until smooth. (For a chunkier texture, you can finely chop the cilantro and stir everything together by hand.)
2. Add 1–2 tbsp water if needed for a thinner, drizzle-style dip.
3. Stir in salt and pepper to your liking.
4. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving to let the flavors develop.

*Serve cold with Crispy Beyond Beef Tacos, burritos, or as a drizzle over bowls and nachos.

Beyond Beef Burritos

SERVES: 2
PREP TIME: 15 minutes
COOK TIME: 15 minutes

INGREDIENTS:
1 package Beyond Beef Ground (16 oz)
4 small whole-grain or corn tortillas
1 cup black beans (cooked or canned, drained & rinsed)
1 avocado, sliced or mashed
½ cup diced tomatoes or pico de gallo
¼ cup diced onions
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt & pepper to taste

PREPARATION:
1. Cook the Beyond Beef
• Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
• Add the Beyond Beef Ground.
• Break apart with a spatula and cook 6-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and hot throughout.
• Season lightly with salt & pepper.

2. Warm the tortillas
• Heat tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30-60 seconds per side, OR wrap in foil and warm in the oven at 350°F for 5 minutes until soft.

3. Prepare the fillings
• Drain and rinse black beans. Warm in a small saucepan or microwave if desired.
• Slice or mash avocado.
• Dice tomatoes (or use pico) and onions.

4. Assemble the burritos
• Lay out tortillas.
• Add a scoop of black beans and a spoonful of cooked Beyond Beef.
• Top with avocado, lettuce, tomatoes/pico, and onions.
• Roll tightly: fold in the sides, then roll up from the bottom.

Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 15 mins
Total Time: 30 mins
Yields: 4–6 cones

Ingredients:

Cones:
4–6 medium flour tortillas
Toothpicks
Spray oil

Filling:
1 lb Beyond Beef
1 packet taco seasoning
1 can black beans, drained and rinsed (optional)

Toppings (optional):
Plant-based sour cream
Guacamole
Pico de gallo
Shredded lettuce

Preparation:

Bake the Cones:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

2. Roll tortillas into cone shapes and secure with toothpicks. Place a crumpled piece of foil inside each cone to help hold its shape.

3. Arrange cones on baking sheet, spray lightly with oil, and bake for 10–15 minutes, until golden brown. Remove toothpicks and foil. Set aside.

Cook the Filling:
1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add Beyond Beef and cook for 5–7 minutes, until browned.

2. Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water. Cook for 2 more minutes until well coated.

3. Mix in black beans if desired.

Assemble the Taco Cones:
1. Spoon taco filling into each baked tortilla cone.

2. Top with nondairy sour cream, guacamole, pico de gallo, and lettuce.

3. Serve warm and enjoy!

SERVINGS: 2 Beyond Burger Patty Melts
PREP TIME: 10 Minutes
COOK TIME: 10 minutes

INGREDIENTS:
1 pack of Beyond Burgers
4 slices of sourdough
1 tbsp plant-based butter, melted
½ cup arugula
2-4 slices plant-based cheese
2 tbsp plant-based pesto
1 heirloom tomato, sliced

PREPARATION:

1. Preheat the flat top (or a pan) to low heat. Allow a few moments for the flat top to be consistently heated.

2. Add Beyond Burgers and cook per packaging instructions.

3. As the Beyond Burgers cook on the flat top, spread plant-based butter on the sourdough bread slices and toast on the lowest setting the flat top will allow for 3-4 minutes, flipping once golden-brown.

4. Add plant-based cheese slices to one sourdough slice per patty melt, along with a little bit of water around the slice, and cover to melt the cheese. Remove slices of bread from the flat top to begin assembling.

5. Coat the other half of the patty melt with plant-based pesto and arugula. Top with the sourdough slice with melted cheese and a large heirloom tomato slice. Add the cooked Beyond Burger patty and assemble. Optional: Add the sandwich back on the flat top to toast further. Cut in half and serve.

Garlic Bread Burger 

Prep Time: 25 mins 
Cook Time: 20 mins 
Serves: 2 burgers 

INGREDIENTS

Garlic Bread Buns:
2 hamburger buns 
2 tbsp plant-based butter, softened 
2 cloves garlic, minced 
1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 
Pinch of salt & black pepper 

Patties:
4 Beyond Burger patties 
Salt & pepper or burger seasoning, to taste 
2 slices plant-based cheese 
Shredded lettuce 

Secret Sauce:
¼ cup plant-based mayo 
2 tbsp ketchup 
1 tsp yellow mustard 
2 tsp pickle relish 
¼ tsp paprika 
2 tbsp finely chopped white onion 

PREPARATION

Garlic Bread Buns:
1. In a small bowl, mix nondairy butter, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper until combined. 

2. Spread mixture evenly over the cut sides of each bun. 

3. Place buns cut-side down in a skillet over medium-high heat, pressing gently with a spatula or burger press. 

4. Toast 3–5 minutes per side, until golden brown and fragrant. Set aside. 

Patties:
1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. 

2. Season Beyond Burger patties with salt and pepper, then press gently with a spatula or burger press. Cook 3–4 minutes per side until browned. 

3. Add a slice of nondairy cheese to one patty, cover briefly to melt, then stack a plain patty on top of the cheesy patty to form a double burger. Repeat for the second burger. 

Sauce:
1. In a small bowl, whisk together mayo, ketchup, mustard, relish, paprika, and onion until smooth. 

 Assemble the Burger:
1. Layer shredded lettuce on the bottom garlic bun. 

2. Place the stacked Beyond patties on top. 

3. Spread sauce onto the top bun. 

4. Close the burger with the sauced garlic bun. 

5. Serve warm with extra sauce on the side.

Beyond Beef Cheeseburger Sliders

SERVINGS: 12 Sliders
PREP TIME: 10 Minutes
COOK TIME: 10 minutes

INGREDIENTS:
1 lb of Beyond Beef
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp black pepper
½ tbsp yellow mustard

Burger Sauce:
1/3 cup plant-based mayo
1 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp mustard
½ tbsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp smoked paprika
2 tbsp pickles, diced finely

Sliders:
12 plant-based slider buns
1 onion, diced
6 slices plant-based cheese
1 tbsp plant-based butter, melted
Sesame seeds, to garnish
1 cup romaine lettuce, thinly chopped
12 pickle slices

PREPARATION:
1. Preheat the flat top to low heat. Allow a few moments for the flat top to be consistently heated.

2. Add diced onions to one side of the flat top and sautee to lightly brown. Add Beyond Beef to the flatop and season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and black pepper. Cook per packaging instructions.

3. As the Beyond Beef and onion is cooking on the flat top, mix plant-based mayo, ketchup, yellow mustard, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and finely diced pickles in a small bowl to create the burger sauce.

4. Turn down to the lowest setting on one of the burners and add the bottom half of the slider to the flat top, open-faced. Add plant-based cheese slices, add a little bit of water around the buns, and cover to melt.

5. Add the Beyond Beef, grilled onions, and a sprinkle of plant-based cheese shreds. Add a little water around the sliders to steam and cover to melt. Remove the cover and add pickle slices to each slider. Cover the sliders with lettuce and drizzle with burger sauce. Place the top buns back on the sliders.

6. Coat the top of the slider buns with melted plant-based butter and generously coat with sesame seeds. Remove from heat and serve.

½ tsp cumin
1 green bell pepper, cut into thin strips
1 onion, cut into thin slices 
½ tsp oregano
¼ tsp black pepper
½ cup plant-based cheddar cheese shreds of choice
10-12 small, fajita-sized flour tortillas

Cilantro Lime Sauce
⅓ cup plant-based sour cream
⅓ cup cilantro 
Juice of 2 limes
1 avocado
1 tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ cup water (adjust as needed)

PREPARATION: 
1. Preheat your griddle or flattop grill to medium-high heat and add green pepper and onion slices, seasoning with ½ tsp oregano and ¼ tsp black pepper. Add Beyond Beef next to the peppers and onions, seasoning the beef with 1 tsp each of garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder, along with 2 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp cumin. 

2. Blend together all cilantro lime sauce ingredients in a high-power blender. Start with only 1-2 Tbs of water and add more for a thinner texture. 

3. Once peppers and onions are starting to get a brown edge and the Beef is cooked through (following package instructions), grab flour tortillas.

4. Toast flour tortillas for 30 seconds on the flat top and fill with cooked Beyond Beef, peppers and onions, and 1-2 Tbs of plant-based cheese shreds. Fold in half and lay down on one side on the flat top. Repeat with additional flour tortillas until all Beyond Beef and peppers and onions are used up, about 10-12 tacos. 

5. Let the tacos toast on one side and flip once you get the desired toastiness. Once toasted, serve tacos up with a thick spread or squeeze of cilantro lime sauce.

Beyond Beef Tater Tot Sliders

Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: About 12 sliders

Ingredients
1 package (16 oz) Beyond Beef
Salt, pepper, garlic powder
1 bag frozen tater rounds
Plant-based cheese slices (cut into squares)
Pickles, sliced
Plant-based BBQ sauce
Olive oil or vegetable oil (for cooking)

Instructions

1. Flatten Beyond Beef to about ½-inch thick on parchment paper. Cut into ~1-inch squares. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.

2. Heat a cast iron or non-stick skillet over medium-high with a drizzle of oil. Cook the mini patties 2–3 minutes per side. Add plant-based cheese on top after flipping and let it melt. Set aside.

5. Stick a toothpick through the center to hold it all together. Serve immediately and enjoy!

📹: @theveganpigeon 

SERVINGS: 1
PREP TIME: 5 minutes
COOK TIME: 10-15 minutes

NGREDIENTS:
1 pack of Beyond Burgers (two burgers)
1-2 jalapeños, sliced thin (about 12 thin slices needed)
2 slices of plant-based cheese of choice
¼ cup of japeño flavored kettle cooked chips (or other potato chips of choice)
One burger bun of choice
1-2 tbsp fig jam or other similar sweet jam

Jalapeño Popper Cream Cheese Spread
2 tbsp plant-based cream cheese
1 tbsp plant-based sour cream
1 tsp fresh dill, finely minced
1 tsp cilantro, finely minced
1 tsp parsley, finely minced
1 tsp finely diced jalapeño
1 tbsp plant-based cheese shreds

PREPARATION:
1. To make the jalapeño popper cream cheese spread, mix together all ingredients from plant-based cream cheese to plant-based cheese shreds, and set aside.

2. Preheat your griddle or flattop grill to medium-high heat and add two piles of 2-3 jalapeño slices each. Add each burger patty to the jalapeños, and use a burger smasher or large pot to gently smash each burger patty down into the jalapeño slices.

3. Cook each burger for about four minutes before gently flipping, making sure to keep the jalapeños with the burger. Cook for about 4 minutes on the other side and gently flip again.

4. Add a slice of plant-based cheese along with an additional 2-3 jalapeño slices on top of each patty, adding a bit of water (no more than 1 tsp) around the burgers and covering to let steam until cheese is melted. If desired, toast the bun on the griddle for a few minutes.

5. Assemble the smash burger, starting with coating the toasted bun with the jalapeño popper cream cheese spread, followed by layering the two burgers, adding a heap of jalapeño chips, and spreading fig jam on the top bun. Cut in half for easy eating and enjoy!

Servings: 3 (Yields 6–8 mini tacos)
Prep Time: 15 mins
Cook Time: 10 mins

Ingredients:
Tacos:
*1 pack (12 oz) Beyond Beef Plant-Based Ground
*6–8 mini tortillas
*6–8 slices plant-based cheddar cheese
*1 cup shredded lettuce
*½ cup diced onion
*½ cup pickle chips
*1 tbsp sesame seeds

Burger Sauce:
*½ cup plant-based mayo
*1 tbsp yellow mustard
*2 tbsp sweet relish
*1 tsp white vinegar
*½ tsp paprika

Instructions:
1. Make the Burger Sauce:
In a bowl, combine mayo, mustard, relish, vinegar, diced onion, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and pepper. Stir until well combined and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let the flavors meld.

2. Shape and Cook the Tacos:
Heat a skillet over high heat and add a small amount of oil.

Take 2–3 tablespoons of Beyond Beef and press it directly onto one side of each mini tortilla to form an even layer.

Place the meat-side down into the hot skillet. Immediately reduce heat to medium-low.

Cook for 4–5 minutes until the Beyond Beef is browned and cooked through.

Flip and cook the other side of the tortilla for 1–2 minutes until slightly crisp.

3. Assemble:
While warm, top each taco with a slice of vegan cheddar cheese so it melts.

Add shredded lettuce, diced onion, and pickle chips.

Drizzle with burger sauce.

Sprinkle with sesame seeds for that iconic finish.

📹: @madison_.eats

Pickle Bun Beyond Burger

Servings: 2
Prep Time: 5 minutes
Cook Time: 15 minutes

Ingredients:
2 cups shredded plant-based cheddar cheese
8 dill pickle slices, thinly sliced
2 Beyond Burger patties
Optional toppings: plant-based mayo, mustard, lettuce, tomato, red onion

Preparation:
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper for easy cleanup.

2. Prep the pickles: Lay the pickle slices between paper towels and press gently to remove excess moisture. This helps the cheese crisp up properly and stick.

3. Form the “pickle bread”: On the parchment-lined baking sheet, divide ½ cup of shredded cheese into 4 piles, shaping each into a square or circle about the size of your burger patty. Lay 2 pickle slices on top of each cheese pile, then sprinkle a little extra cheese on top to “seal” the pickles in.

4. Bake: Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden and the cheese is crisp. Let the “bread” cool completely before assembling the burger—this helps them firm up.

5. Cook the Beyond Burgers: While the pickle bread cools, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the Beyond Burger patties for about 4 minutes per side, or until heated through and slightly crisp on the edges.

6. Assemble: Use two crispy pickle-cheese “breads” for each burger. Layer with Beyond patty, lettuce, tomato, onion, mayo, and mustard—or your favorite fixings.

Pro tip: Let the cheese cool completely before handling, it helps prevent breakage and keeps the texture satisfyingly crispy.

Crispy Rice and Beyond Steak Salad 

Servings: 2–3 people as a main dish or 4 people as a side.  

Prep Time: 10 minutes 
Cook Time: 10 minutes 

INGREDIENTS:
Crispy Rice: 
2 cups leftover rice 
1 tbsp soy sauce (or coconut aminos) 
1 tsp chili oil 

Beyond Steak: 
1 package Beyond Steak 
1 tbsp olive oil 
1/2 tsp garlic powder 
1/2 tsp onion powder 
Salt and pepper to taste 

Salad: 
1/2 cucumber, thinly sliced 
1/2 cup edamame, cooked 
1 avocado, diced 
1/4 red onion, thinly sliced 
2 green onions, chopped 

Asian Dressing: 
1/4 cup olive oil 
1/4 cup toasted sesame oil 
3 tbsp soy sauce (or coconut aminos) 
3 tbsp rice vinegar 
2 tbsp maple syrup or agave  
1 1/2 tsp ground ginger 
1/2 tsp kosher salt 
1/2 cup non-dairy mayo (optional, for a creamy texture) 

PREPARATION:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a bowl, mix the leftover rice with soy sauce and chili oil until evenly coated. Spread the rice onto a parchment-lined baking sheet in a thin layer. Bake for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and golden brown. 

2. Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add olive oil. Toss Beyond Steak pieces with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and slightly crispy. Remove from heat. 

3. In a small bowl or jar, whisk together olive oil, toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, ground ginger, salt, and non-dairy mayo (if using). 

4. In a large bowl, combine cucumber, edamame, avocado, red onion, and green onions. Add the crispy rice and cooked Beyond Steak on top. Drizzle with the dressing and toss gently to combine. 

5. Serve immediately and enjoy this crispy, savory, and fresh salad!

column3:
SERVES: 4
PREP TIME: 30 minutes
COOK TIME: 15 minutes

INGREDIENTS:
Main Wrap:
1 bag Beyond Steak
4 pita breads (store-bought, pizza dough, or homemade – see Pita section)
8 tbsp Toum (see Toum section)
12 tomato slices
2 cups baby spinach
8 cucumber slices (English or Persian, long and thin)
16 pickled turnip pieces (see Pickled Turnip section)
3 tbsp shawarma spice (store-bought)
2 cups tabbouleh (see Tabbouleh section)
4 tbsp avocado or olive oil
2 tbsp chopped fresh mint
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
Toum (Garlic Sauce)
15 garlic cloves
1 ½ cups oil
⅛ cup lemon juice
½ tbsp kosher salt
⅛ cup ice water

Tabbouleh:
1 cup cooked quinoa
4 tbsp minced shallot
½ tbsp chopped fresh mint
3 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
2 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste

Pickled Turnips:
1 medium turnip, peeled and cut into matchsticks
1 medium red beet, peeled and cut into matchsticks
1 garlic clove
1¾ cups filtered water
1 cup white vinegar
¼ cup kosher salt

PREPARATION:
Pickled Turnips:
1. Place turnip, beet, and garlic into a heat-safe container.
2. Bring water, vinegar, and salt to a boil in a small pot.
3. Pour hot liquid over veggies to fully submerge.
4. Let cool, then refrigerate.

Toum:
1. Blend garlic and salt in a small food processor until finely minced.
2. Add lemon juice and pulse again.
3. Slowly drizzle in oil and ice water while blending.
4. Blend until light and fluffy. Set aside.

Tabbouleh:
1. In a bowl, combine quinoa, shallot, mint, parsley, lemon juice, and olive oil.
2. Mix well and season with salt. Set aside.

Beyond Steak:
1. Prepare steak tips according to package instructions.
2. Once cooked, turn off heat and toss with shawarma spice.

Assemble the Wraps:
1. Brush pita with olive oil.
2. Spread 2 tbsp of toum on each pita.
3. Add tabbouleh on top.
4. Layer with baby spinach, tomato slices, pickled turnips, cucumber, and steak.
5. Sprinkle chopped mint and parsley over the top.
6. Serve open-faced and enjoy!

column2: Cellentani Pasta Salad
column3:
Here’s to delicious meals and unforgettable moments with family and friends! Brighten your table with a vibrant cellentani pasta salad, a colourful dish bursting with fresh flavours. 💙

Ingredients:

340g Barilla Cellentani 

4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

2 tbsp red wine vinegar 

1⁄2 tsp dried oregano 

1 pinch sugar

sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 

160g sliced artichoke hearts, drained 

80g pitted mixed olives

1 bell pepper, finely sliced

160g cherry tomatoes, quartered

1 red onion, finely sliced

200g mozzarella pearls/balls, drained 

100g Italian salami, finely sliced

4 tbsp parmesan shavings 

Method:

1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Cellentani according to package instructions, until al dente, then drain.
2. Whisk the extra virgin olive oil, vinegar and oregano together and season with sugar, salt and black pepper.
3. Toss the pasta with 3⁄4 of the dressing until fully coated.
4. Add the remaining ingredients and toss until combined.
5. Divide between serving plates and drizzle with the remaining dressing and parmesan shavings.

column2: Fancy trying something different? Check this Mediterranean recipe with Pesto Basilico E Limone!
column3:
Fancy trying something different? this Mediterranean Vegetable and Apple Spaghetti with Pesto Basilico E Limone is full of flavors you will not want to miss trying 🍝🍋​

Ingredients 
320g Barilla Spaghetti 
1 jar (190g) Barilla Pesto Basilico e Limone 
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 
100g red onion, roughly chopped 
100g fennel, roughly chopped plus fennel fronds 
100g courgette, roughly chopped 
1 red apple, roughly chopped 
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 

Method 
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Barilla Spaghetti according to packet instructions, until al dente. Drain and remove from the heat. 
2. Heat a skillet until hot. 
3. Add the olive oil and red onion, fennel and courgettes and sauté for 4-5 minutes until tender. Add the apple and fry for another minute, then season to taste. 
4. Toss the pasta and vegetables together then spoon in the Pesto Basilico e Limone and stir until combined.
5. Divide the pasta between serving plates and top with fennel fronds.
6. Serve and enjoy. 

#PestoLimone #Barilla

column2: This Focaccia with Smoked Salmon and Pesto Basilico e Limone will take your night to the next level!
column3:
Looking for some meal time inspiration? this Focaccia with Smoked Salmon, Red Onion Compote, and Pesto Basilico e Limone is the answer. The sweet red onion compote and zesty pesto make for a match made in sandwich heaven. 🍋 🐟

Ingredients (serves 4): 
80g Barilla Pesto Basilico e Limone
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
200g red onion, finely sliced 
25g caster sugar
50ml balsamic vinegar
4 pieces focaccia, split in half
40g pea shoots
160g sliced smoked salmon
Freshly ground black pepper

Method:
1. Heat a skillet until hot. Add the olive oil and onions and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes until softened.
2. Add the sugar and balsamic vinegar and continue to cook gently for another 10 minutes until soft and slightly sticky.
3. Remove from the heat and set aside.
4. Split the focaccia in half widthways and spread the bottom piece with the Pesto Basilico e Limone.
5. Top with the red onion compote, pea shoots and smoked salmon.
6. Season with a little black pepper.
7. Cover with the top half of the focaccia and serve. 

#PestoLimone #Barilla

column2: The perfect blend of sweet and bitter flavors: Pesto Limone focaccia panzanella salad!
column3:
Treat yourself to a delightful twist with our Pesto Limone Focaccia Panzanella Salad! The perfect blend of sweet and bitter flavors 🍋 

Ingredients (serves 4):
150g focaccia bread, cut into 1cm cubes
150g sweet mini peppers, seeded and sliced
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
150g red radicchio, thinly sliced
200g cherry tomatoes, halved
2 green apples, finely sliced
200g feta, crumbled
1 jar Barilla Pesto Basilico e Limone
25g flaked toasted almonds

Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 200°C, fan 180°C, gas mark 4.
2. Toss the bread and peppers with half the oil and season with salt and black pepper.
3. Tip onto a baking tray and roast in the oven for 10 minutes until the croutons and crunchy and the pepper tender.
4. Tip the croutons and peppers, radicchio, tomatoes, apples and feta into a bowl.
5. Gently stir in the Barilla Pesto Basilico e Limone and toss everything together.
6. Divide between serving plates and top with the toasted almonds. 

#PestoLimone #Barilla

column2: The perfect recipe for busy weeknights or a light meal!
column3:
Quick, easy, and oh-so-delicious! This pasta dish is fresh, flavourful, and ready in minutes—perfect for busy weeknights or a light meal! 🍝 

Ingredients (serves 4-6):

340g Barilla Gemelli 
2 red peppers, seeded and sliced 
200g cherry tomatoes, halved 
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 
300g tuna
2 tbsp red wine vinegar 
1 red onion, finely chopped 
2 sticks celery, finely sliced 
3 tbsp flat leaf parsley leaves

Method:

1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Gemelli according to packet instructions until al dente, then drain. 
2. Heat a skillet until hot. Add the oil and prosciutto and fry on each side until golden and crispy. 
3. Remove and drain onto kitchen paper. 
4. Pour the balsamic vinegar into the pan and stir until combined. 
5. Toss the pasta with the warm dressing until coated. 
6. Add the melon, mozzarella, rocket, basil and half the pine nuts. Toss until combined. 
7. Crumble half the crispy prosciutto into the salad and toss together. 
8. Season with salt and black pepper and divide between serving plates. 
9. Crumble the remaining crispy prosciutto over the top, add the pine nuts and serve.


#ASignOfLove #Barilla #pasta

column2: The most  irresistible Mediterranean Orzo salad!
column3:
Every bite of this irresistible pasta salad will transport your taste buds to the sunny shores of the Mediterranean 🌞

Ingredients (serves 4):
160g Barilla Orzo
2/3 cucumber
300g medium tomatoes 
1 red onion
80g stoned Kalamata olives
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1⁄2 tsp oregano
200g feta, crumbled
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orzo according to package instructions.
2. Meanwhile, finely chop the cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olives and tip into a bowl. 
3. Drain the orzo and add to the bowl. 
4. Pour over the vinegar, olive oil and oregano. Season with salt and black pepper and mix together. 
5. Carefully stir in the crumbled feta.
6. Serve warm or allow to cool and place in a sealed container in the fridge. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Treat yourself to this vegan linguine masterpiece
column3:
Don't know what to cook for dinner? Treat yourself to this vegan linguine masterpiece. 🍄 

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Vegan Linguine
4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
100g shallots, finely diced
4 garlic cloves, finely chopped
600g mixed mushrooms – white, chestnut, portabellini, sliced 
1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves 
3 tbsp tomato puree 
200ml vegetable stock
80g walnuts
20g nutritional yeast flakes 
1 tsp sea salt 
4 tbsp flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine according to package instructions.
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water. 
3. Heat a large skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil and shallots and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened. 
4. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. 
5. Add the mushrooms and thyme and cook over a medium heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring until they are golden and have released the juices. 
6. Stir in the tomato puree and cook for 1 minute. 
7. Add the vegetable stock and bring to a simmer. 
8. Tip the walnuts into a blender, add the yeast flakes, salt and parsley and blitz to a powder. 
9. Stir 2/3 into the pasta, then season with black pepper. 
10. Add the linguine and toss until coated, add a little pasta water until you have a creamy sauce. (It might be not necessary to pour in all the pasta water.) 
11. Serve and enjoy!

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: The perfect seafood spaghetti recipe, a tribute to sunny summer days!
column3:
This recipe is a perfect ode to the sunny days ahead! 🎣

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Collezione Linguine 
4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
100g shallots, finely chopped 
100ml white wine 
2 tbsp tomato puree
400g tinned chopped tomatoes
60g mixed pitted olives
200g white fish, skinned and cut into cubes 
300g mussels, cleaned
200g squid, cut into rings
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 
handful basil leaves 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine according to package instructions. 
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water. 
3. Heat a large skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil and shallots and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened. 
4. Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half then stir in the tomato puree and cook for 1 minute. 
5. Add the tomatoes and olives, bring to a simmer and cook for 3 minutes. 
6. Stir in the white fish, cover with a lid and simmer for 4 minutes. 
7. Stir in the mussels and squid, cover and simmer for another 3 minutes. 
8. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. 
9. Add the linguine and toss until coated, adding a little pasta water if necessary. 
10. Serve topped with basil. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Collezione

column2: Pancetta and peas Orecchiette recipe: the perfect dish to savour on those sunny summer evenings!
column3:
Bursting with fresh, vibrant flavours, this light and refreshing dish with pancetta and peas is the perfect dish to savour on those sunny summer evenings! 🍝

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Orecchiette
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
200g cubed pancetta
1 onion, finely chopped
1⁄2 tsp chilli flakes
320g frozen peas
250ml vegetable stock
50g pecorino cheese, grated
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 
3 tbsp mint leaves, chopped 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orecchiette according to package instructions. 
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water. 
3. Heat a large skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil and pancetta to the pan and cook for 3- 4 minutes on a medium heat until crispy and the fat has rendered out. 
4. Add the onions and chilli flakes and cook for another 2 minutes. 
5. Stir in the peas and vegetable stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until the peas are tender. 
6. Stir in 3⁄4 of the pecorino and 2/3 of the mint leaves. 
7. Add the orecchiette and toss until coated, add a little pasta water at a time until you have a creamy sauce. (It might be not necessary to pour in all the pasta water.) 
8. Serve topped with the last of the cheese and mint. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: The perfect recipe with pancetta & pistachio linguine for special moments with those who matter most
column3:
This easy-to-prepare dish is not only bursting with flavour but also perfect for sharing special moments with those who matter most. So, who will you be inviting to join you for a memorable night at the dinner table? 💝

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Linguine
200g cubed pancetta 100g pistachio, plus 20g
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 
1 onion, finely chopped 
4 sage leaves, shredded
200ml white wine
200ml double cream
50g parmesan, finely grated
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine according to package instructions. 
2. Drain and reserve 200ml of the cooking water. 
3. Heat a skillet until medium hot, add the pancetta and cook for 3-4 minutes on a medium heat, until crispy and the fat has rendered out. 
4. Add the pistachio and toast for 2 minutes then remove both and set aside. 
5. Add the extra virgin olive oil and onions and sage and cook for another 2 minutes. Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half. 
6. Pour in the double cream and the pancetta and pistachio, bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes. 
7. Stir in the parmesan, and season with salt and black pepper. 
8. Add the linguine and toss until coated, add a little pasta water until you have a creamy sauce. (It might be not necessary to pour in all the pasta water.) 
9. Serve topped with the remaining pistachios. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Heat up your plate with a kick of spice with this rigatoni recipe
column3:
Heat up your plate with a kick of spice with this rigatoni recipe 🌶️🍝 

Ingredients:
320g Barilla Rigatoni
100g butter
200g shallots, finely chopped 
1-2 tbsp chilli sauce 
4 tbsp white miso
100g parmesan, finely grated
3 spring onions, finely chopped 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni according to package instructions.
2. Drain and reserve 250ml of the cooking water. 
3. Heat a skillet until medium hot, add the butter and heat until just foaming then add the shallots. 
4. Cook gently for 6-8 minutes until softened. 
5. Stir in the chilli sauce, white miso and all the cooking water and whisk until smooth and emulsified. 
6. Add the parmesan and whisk again until smooth. 
7. Stir in the rigatoni and toss until totally coated. 
8. Serve topped with the spring onion and a little extra parmesan 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Let's celebrate the end of spring with this cheerful Minestrone Ditalini recipe!
column3:
Spring has sprung, and so has the flavour in this cheerful minestrone! 🌞

Ingredients (serves 4):
200g Barilla Ditalini
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 
1 red onion, chopped 
200g carrots, chopped 
150g celery, chopped 
1 leek, sliced
3 garlic cloves, minced
2 tsp oregano
2 tbsp tomato puree
400g tinned chopped tomatoes
1.5 litre vegetable stock
100g Cavolo nero, sliced thinly
400g tin cannellini beans, drained 
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 
30g Parmesan, finely grated 

Method: 
1. Heat a sauté pan until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil, onions, carrots, celery, leek, garlic and oregano, cover with a lid and cook gently for 10 minutes until just softened. 
2. Add the tomato puree, tinned tomatoes and stock, stir well, bring to the boil, cover and simmer for 5 minutes.
3. Add the orzo, cover and simmer for 8 minutes until just al dente, stirring occasionally. 
4. Stir in the Cavolo nero and beans and return to a simmer for 2 minutes. 
5. Season with salt and black pepper. 
6. Divide between serving bowls and top with the parmesan. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: The best mouthwatering pasta dish with the freshest vegetables and creamy ricotta
column3:
On the menu tonight: the ultimate veggie delight! This mouthwatering pasta dish with the freshest vegetables and creamy ricotta is always a crowd pleaser! 🌿🍅

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Penne Rigate
400g Barilla Ricotta Sauce
1 aubergine, roughly chopped
1 courgette, thickly sliced
1 red onion, cut into wedges
200g cherry tomatoes
1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
125g ricotta cheese
2 tbsp basil 

Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 210°C.
2. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne according to package instructions.
3. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water. 
4. Toss the aubergines, courgettes, red onion and cherry tomatoes with the thyme, salt, black pepper and extra virgin olive oil. 
5. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes until just browned and tender. 
6. Heat a skillet until hot, add the ricotta sauce and roasted vegetables. 
7. Add the Penne and toss until coated, adding the pasta water little by little and cooking for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce. 
8. Stir in the ricotta and serve topped with the basil. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Summer is coming, let's celebrate it with this tasty Farfalle blue cheese and pear recipe!
column3:
With a hint of spring and summer in a bowl, this farfalle pasta salad with soft blue cheese and pear is perfect for an al fresco meal at any time! 

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Farfalle
100ml red wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1⁄4 tsp sea salt
1 red onion, finely sliced
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 ripe pears, cut into small wedges
100g salted roasted pecans
2 tbsp finely chopped chives
250g Italian soft blue cheese, roughly chopped 
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 

Method: 
1.Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the farfalle according to package instructions. 
2. Meanwhile, pour the vinegar, honey and salt into a saucepan and bring to a simmer. Add the red onions, stir well then cover and set aside for 10 minutes. 
3. Drain 2 tablespoons of pickling liquor from the onions and whisk with the olive oil. 
4. Toss the pasta with the dressing, pears, pecans, pickled red onions, chives and Italian soft blue cheese. 
5. Season with salt and black pepper. 
6. Serve warm or cold and enjoy!

column2: The most delicious roasted lemon and rocket Spaghetti recipe!
column3:
This pasta with a tangy twist makes for an unforgettable evening at the dinner table! 🍋

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Spaghetti
1 lemon, thinly sliced
2 tbsp honey
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 
80g rocket 
80g shelled pistachios, roughly chopped 
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper 
250g mozzarella, torn 

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions. 
2. Drain and reserve 200ml of the cooking water. 
3. Preheat the oven to 210°C.
4. Lay the lemon slices onto a roasting tray and drizzle with a little honey. Place in the oven to roast for 10 minutes until browned and slightly dry. 
5. Finely chop the lemon and tip into a bowl with the olive oil and honey. 
6. Season with salt and black pepper and whisk until combined. 
7. Toss the lemon dressing with the drained spaghetti, rocket and 3⁄4 of the pistachios. 
8. Season to taste and add a little cooking water at a time until the pasta is coated in dressing. 
9. Tear the mozzarella on top, add the last of the pistachios and serve. 

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: The perfect and the most tasty vegan pesto asparagus Fusilli recipe!
column3:
Here's a perfectly quick and tasty dish that’s ready in just about the time it takes to cook the pasta! 

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Fusilli
190g Barilla Vegan Pesto
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
200g fine asparagus spears, cut into 5cm long pieces 
2 mixed peppers, finely sliced
2 tbsp basil leaves 

Method: 
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fusilli according to package instructions.
2. Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil, asparagus and peppers and sauté for 3-4 minutes until brown and tender. 
3. Toss the cooked fusilli with the vegetables and the pesto. Toss until the pasta is coated in the sauce. 
4. Serve topped with basil!

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Create unforgettable moments around the dinner table with this delicious pasta recipe!
column3:
From the kick of spicy sausage to the creamy richness of Arrabbiata sauce, this pasta recipe will create unforgettable moments around the dinner table! 🫶

Ingredients:
320g Barilla Tortiglioni
400g Barilla Arrabbiata sauce
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
250g tender stem broccoli, small florets separated and stem finely sliced 
4 Italian style sausages, skin removed and broken into small pieces
4 garlic cloves, sliced
1 red chilli, finely sliced
15g Parmigiano, grated

Method:
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the tortiglioni according to package instructions.
Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil and broccoli florets and sauté for 3-4 minutes until just tender and charred.
Remove from the pan and set aside.
Add the sausage pieces and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Stir in broccoli stems, garlic and chilli and stir fry for 2 minutes.
Add the Arabiatta sauce, bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until the sausage is cooked and broccoli tender.
Tip in the reserved broccoli and tortiglioni pasta and stir until combined and hot. Add some pasta water and cook for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce.
Serve topped with the Parmigiano.

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: In the mood for a seafood pasta? Check this recipe!
column3:
In the mood for a seafood pasta recipe to whisk you away to sun-drenched coastal bliss? This mix of the sweet succulence of crab meat and fiery kick of chilli peppers is simply irresistible! 🌶️

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Collezione Trigatelli
4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp chilli flakes
300g cooked picked crabmeat – 200g white crabmeat, 100g brown crabmeat
1 lemon, zest grated and ½ juiced
3 tbsp chopped flat leaf parsley
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the trigatelli according to package instructions.
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
3. Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil and chilli flakes and sauté for 1 minute until just toasted.
4. Stir in the crabmeat, lemon zest, juice and half the parsley. Cook for 2-3 minutes until hot.
5. Add the trigatelli and toss until coated, adding the pasta water little by little and cook for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce.
6. Season with lemon juice, salt and black pepper and serve topped with the last of the parsley.

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Let's keep on celebrating spring with this creamy burrata, hearty kale, zesty capers pasta recipe!
column3:
Spring is in full swing with this pasta dish with hearty kale, zesty capers, and creamy burrata! 🌼

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Collezione Trigatelli
4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
4 garlic cloves, finely chopped
250g kale, roughly chopped
4 tbsp capers, drained
2 lemons, zest grated
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 burrata, drained and halved

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the trigatelli according to package instructions.
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
3. Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil and garlic and sauté for 1 minute until just golden.
4. Stir in the kale, cover with a lid and steam for 3-4 minutes until wilted.
5. Stir in ¾ of the capers and the lemon zest and season with salt and black pepper.
6. Add the trigatelli and toss until coated, adding the pasta water little by little and cook for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce.
7. Season with salt and black pepper and serve topped with the burrata, last of the capers and lemon zest and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
8. Serve and enjoy!

column2: Are you dreaming of Naples streets vibes? We have the right pasta recipe for you!
column3:

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Penne Rigate
400g Barilla Napoletana Sauce
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 red onion, sliced
1 celery stick, sliced
200g canned tuna in olive oil
80g Spanish olives, halved
2 tbsp flat leaf parsley

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne according to package instructions.
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
3. Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil, red onion and celery and sauté for 5 minutes until just soft.
4. Add the Napoletana sauce, salt and black pepper.
5. Stir in the tuna and olives and simmer for 1-2 minutes until the tuna is hot.
6. Add the penne and toss until coated, adding the pasta water little by little and cooking for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce.
7. Serve topped with the parsley.

column2: The most irresistible oven-baked pasta recipe!
column3:
Ready to transform your kitchen into a cozy trattoria with our irresistible oven-baked pasta? It's the perfect dish to share with loved ones 🥰

Ingredients (serves 4):
300g Barilla Maccheroni 
200g chorizo, finely chopped
500ml semi-skimmed milk 
2 tbsp cornflour
2 tsp English mustard
150ml double cream
100g Gruyère, grated 
50g Parmesan, grated
1 small bunch basil, roughly chopped + leaves to serve

Topping:
55g fresh breadcrumbs 
30g Gruyère, grated
15g Parmesan, grated
1 tsp paprika 

Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 220°C. Cook the maccheroni according to package instructions.
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
3. Meanwhile put the chorizo into a large frying pan over a medium heat, cook for 4 minutes until crisp. Pour in the milk, bring to a boil and then turn down to a simmer.
4. In a little bowl mix the cornflour with 3 tablespoons of water until it’s dissolved. While whisking, pour the cornflour into the simmering milk mixture. Tip in the mustard, double cream, Gruyère and Parmesan and cook until thickened.
5. Stir in the basil and season to taste. Add the pasta to the pan, stir well then tip into a medium baking or casserole dish.
6. Mix the topping ingredients together and sprinkle over the top of the pasta. Bake for 20 minutes until the top is golden and crisp.
7. Serve and enjoy!

#ASignOfLove #Barilla #Pasta

column2: Taste the real Mediterranean flavours with this Fusilli pasta Recipe!
column3:

Ingredients (serves 4):
320g Barilla Fusilli
4 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 medium onion, sliced
2 garlic cloves, roughly chopped
¼ tsp dried chilli flakes
100ml white wine
1 pinch saffron (optional)
4 tbsp tomato puree
400g chopped tomatoes, canned
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
400g hake or cod, skinned and cubed (2 cm)
1 lemon, zest grated
1 tbsp fennel top, roughly chopped

Method:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fusilli according to package instructions. 
2. Drain and reserve 150ml of the cooking water.
3. Meanwhile, heat a skillet until hot, add the extra virgin olive oil, onion and garlic and sauté for 5 minutes until soft.
4. Add the chilli flakes and stir to combine.
5. Stir in the tomato purée, then add the white wine, bring to the boil and cook until reduced by half.
6. Add the chopped tomatoes, salt and black pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
7. Stir in the hake cubes, cover with a lid and simmer for 3-4 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
8. Add the fusilli and toss until coated, adjusting little by little with the cooking water and cooking for 1 minute to get a creamy sauce.
9. Serve topped with the grated lemon zest and fennel tops.

column2: The delectable vegetarian Trofie with Butternut Squash
column3:
Craving an explosion of flavour? Introducing you to an easy and delectable vegetarian pasta dish with butternut squash that's bound to please everyone at the dinner table. ❤️

Ingredients:
1 box Barilla Al Collezione Trofie
Barilla® Pesto
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 small butternut squash, diced
1 onion, thick cut
1 cup arugula, roughly chopped
½ cup Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, grated
Salt and black pepper to taste

Method:
1. Preheat oven to 220 C. 
2. Boil water in a pot. 
3. Season onion and butternut squash with olive oil, salt and pepper and roast separately in the oven until thoroughly cooked, about 15 minutes. 
4. Cook the pasta according to package directions and drain. Reserve ½ cup of the water. 
5. Take the roasted butternut squash out of the oven and combine with the arugula, pesto and Parmigiano cheese. Add the pasta too. 
6. Blend well and serve.

50g of fresh basil

Method:

column2: You have never tried such delicious spinach and ricotta Lasagne!
column3:
Time to dive into a delight with this flavourful lasagne packed with layers of deliciousness. Who will you be inviting over for dinner?🍴 

Ingredients (serves 4):
Barilla Collezione Lasagne
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp butter
3 tbsps flour
1 cup onion diced
50g packages of frozen spinach
400g ricotta cheese
3 cups milk, gently warmed
1 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese, grated 
salt and black pepper to taste

Method:
1. Preheat the oven to 180 C.
2. In a large skillet sweat the onion in olive oil over moderate heat for 4-5 minutes. Add spinach and season with salt and pepper; sauté for 5 minutes. Remove from heat to cool down.
Ricotta mixture: Combine ricotta, spinach, and ¾ cup Parmigiano cheese; season with salt and pepper.
3. Prepare béchamel sauce: In a sauce pan melt butter and add flour, cook for 2-3 minutes. Add warm milk and bring to a simmer, whisk well so there are no clumps, season with salt and pepper. 
4. When the sauce comes up to a simmer cook for an additional 5 minutes.
5. Build the lasagne: sprinkle the oven tray with bechamel, Top with 4 Lasagne sheets, 1 cup ricotta mixture and a sprinkle of Parmigiano cheese. Continue the same procedure for 3 more layers.
6. For the top layer spread remaining béchamel and ricotta mixture, sprinkle with Parmigiano cheese; bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly on top.
7. Rest for 10 minutes and serve.

column2: Bonus Episode: A Chat with BEM Books
column3: Bells Black food literature – cookbooks, foreign literature, novels, children's’ books, photo books, and any book that has rich, sumptuous descriptions of food. Jade sits with Gabrielle and Danielle Davenport, the sisters behind the first-of-its-kind bookshop.

column2: On Writing Black Food - Video Extension | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: For food writer and editor Chala June, Black food writing is a balm and a connective tissue between our histories, our futures, and each other. Listen to Episode 6 of The Black Kitchen Series: “On Writing Black Food” wherever you get your podcasts.

column2: Ep. 6 – On Writing Black Food with Adrian Miller & Chala June | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: At the end of the journey, back in Brooklyn, and putting all the pieces together. Season 2 host Jade Verette (@JadeofallJades) sits down with Black food historian, Soul Food Scholar, and host of Season 1, Adrian Miller, to make sense of all that she’s encountered over the course of her travels, and why Black food writing lies at the center of it all. Jade also sits down with Chala June to discuss why Black food writing is an act of resistance as much as it is an expression of love.

column2: Bonus Episode: “Tell Michelle I Didn’t Mean It” | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: In addition to being a non-profit founder, executive director, community leader and recipient of very many awards, Kelly Carlisle is also incredibly funny. Hear her tell the story of the time she met President Obama at the White House under the most unexpected of circumstances.

column2: The Healing Power of Food - Video Extension | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: For Chef and Black Food Futurist @nialeeomg, food is a love language. Listen to this week’s episode for more about her story and why she started Stormé Supper Club, a dinner club for Black queer femmes in LA.

column2: Ep. 5–The Healing Power of Food with Kelly Carlisle & Nia Lee | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3:
We all know that food is more than food. It’s medicine – for the body, the soul, the heart…and for the community? The future? The wounds of the past? Host Jade Varette (@JadeofallJades) chases some sunshine in California and meets with two women harnessing the healing power of food in transformative ways: Kelly Carlisle – founder and Executive Director of Acta Non Verba: Youth Urban Farm Project out of Oakland – who is rewriting the narrative around the youth of her community, and chef/artists/Black Food Futurist Nia Lee, who is creating radical sites of healing and joy for Black queer femmes. 

To keep up with ANV news, follow them @anv_farm. You can donate to the mission at anvfarm.org/. To follow Nia on her journey, find her on Instagram at @nialeeomg and @stormesupperclub.

column2: Bonus Episode: Shopping for Mushrooms
column3: Before their interview, Marlon takes Jade on a tour through HiFi Mycology, where he does his daily mushroom shopping. In between descriptions of his favorite mushrooms, the Plant Based G drops some delicious cooking tips, bodybuilding wisdom, and other insights he’s gathered along the way.

column2: The Veganization of Soul Food - Video Extension | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: Episode 4 of The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators is out now! Listen to “The Veganization of Soul Food” with Marlon Rison & Folami Geter.

column2: Ep. 4 – Veganizing Soul Food with Marlon Rison & Folami Geter | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3:
Jade’s (@Jadeofalljades) journey through the South has so far brought her closer to community, closer to family, and now…closer to body? In this episode, vegan chefs Folami Geter of A Peace of Soul Vegan Kitchen in Columbia, SC, and Marlon Rison of Community Vegan in Austin, TX, share how they came to the plant-based lifestyle, what’s keeping them there, and how it connects us to each other and our history in unexpected ways.

Follow Folami’s restaurant on Instagram @peaceofsoulsc and Marlon’s food truck @communityvegan to learn more. And to learn more about Hi-Fi Mycology, check out https://www.hifimyco.com/.

column2: AncientGrains Bonus 16x9
The Renaissance of Ancient Grains - Video Extension | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: Rollen’s only one of a handful of rice growers in the South farming Carolina Gold rice. And he’s one of fewer doing it the old way – flood rice. Learn more about Carolina Gold and another storied and ancient grain, fonio, in this week’s episode of the Black Kitchen Series: Innovators, featuring @RollensRawGrains & @thizzg.

column2: Ep. 3 – Ancient Grains | Rollen Chalmers & Amethyst Ganaway | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3:
In our next stops on this road trip, we go straight to the heart of the Lowcountry to learn about two ancient and storied grains making big waves today: fonio and Carolina Gold rice. At James Island, our host Jade (@JadeofallJades) chats with matriarch in the making, Amethyst Ganaway (@thizzg) of Yolélé, about the so-called seed of the universe, before heading further south to Hardeeville, where she meets with master rice grower, Rollen Chalmers of Rollen’s Raw Grains (@RollensRawGrains). We may be far from home now, but Jade finds herself closer to her roots than ever before…

To learn more about Yolélé’s mission, head to Yolele.com. And to purchase Carolina Gold rice from Rollen himself, head to RollensRawGrains.com

column2: Bonus Episode: The Red Rice Day Proclamation | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: In this week’s main episode, our guest, KJ Kearney (@BlackFoodFridays) mentions the Red Rice Day Proclamation he penned that was unanimously ratified by the City of Charleston. We asked him to read a selection of the text…

column2: Ep.2 – Community Through FoodTok w/ KJ Kearney | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: KJ Kearney is the charismatic, community-oriented influencer driven by the love of his people. He may be behind the James Beard nominated @BlackFoodFridays TikTok and Instagram accounts, but what drives him goes much deeper than what you can find on the internet. Jade (@JadeofallJades) spends the day with him in Charleston and Savannah, and chats with him to find out how (and why) he’s making sense of social in this day and age.

column2: Community Through FoodTok - Video Extension | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: KJ is the charismatic people person behind the popular and James Beard–nominated @BlackFoodFridays accounts, but with him it’s deeper than the internet. column2: Farm to Bottle - Video Extension | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3: Somewhere on Cherry Street, in Helena, Arkansas, the only Black family–owned farm-to-bottle in the country is distilling sweet potatoes into spirits. Listen to their story: https://the-black-kitchen-initiative.simplecast.com/

column2: Ep. 1 – Farm to Bottle with Delta Dirt Distillery | The Black Kitchen Series: Innovators
column3:

Der Bau von Lindts Schokoladenhaus markiert einen wichtigen Meilenstein in der Schweizer Schokoladengeschichte. Die gemeinnützige Lindt Chocolate Competence Foundation wurde 2013 gegründet und finanziert und realisiert dieses Großprojekt auf dem Werksgelände von Lindt & Sprüngli im schweizerischen Kilchberg.

Die Pläne für das Multifunktionsgebäude wurden von den Basler Architekten Christ & Gantenbein erstellt. Das moderne Design setzt ein markantes Gegengewicht zum historischen Lindt & Sprüngli-Fabrikgebäude von 1899 und fügt sich perfekt in die bestehende Umgebung in Kilchberg ein.

Das visionäre Bauprojekt am Stammsitz von Lindt & Sprüngli in Kilchberg hat das Ziel, langfristig zur Zukunft des Wirtschaftsstandortes Schokolade in der Schweiz beizutragen. Gleichzeitig wird die Pionierarbeit der ehemaligen Firmengründer fortgesetzt. Mit Erfindergeist und Geschäftssinn machten die Pioniere die Schweizer Schokolade weltweit bekannt und verankerten sie in der nationalen Identität.

column2: LINDT Home of Chocolate - a unique vision that takes shape!
column3:
For further info visit https://www.lindt-spruengli.com/lindt-home-of-chocolate/

The building of Lindt’s Home of Chocolate marks a major milestone in the Swiss chocolate history. Founded in 2013, the charitable Lindt Chocolate Competence Foundation is funding and realising this major project on Lindt & Sprüngli’s factory premises in Kilchberg, Switzerland. 

The plans for the multifunctional building were drawn up by Basel-based architects Christ & Gantenbein. The modern design presents a striking counterbalance to the historical Lindt & Sprüngli factory building from 1899 and fits perfectly into the existing surroundings in Kilchberg. 

The visionary construction project at Lindt & Sprüngli's headquarters in Kilchberg has the aim of contributing towards the future of Switzerland as a business location for chocolate for the long-term. At the same time continuing the pioneering work of the former company founders. With their spirit of invention and business sense, the pioneers made Swiss chocolate famous across the world and embedded it into the national identity.

LINDT brand ambassador Roger Federer and Maître Chocolatier Stefan Bruderer ceremoniously opened the newly designed LINDT Chocolate Boutique at Zurich Airport. Following the official opening, the world-famous tennis star visibly enjoyed the unique chocolate tour by Lindt Maître chocolatier Stefan Bruderer, who personally guided the star guest through the Chocolate Boutique and presented him with all the highlights that chocolate fans from all over the world can expect on 130 m² of sales space.

column2: Why LINDT chocolate is special
column3:
Chocolate, back then
The year was 1879. Rodolphe Lindt, the son of a Bernese pharmacist, wanted to produce chocolate. Now you should know that chocolate at the time was hard: hard to process and hard to eat.  You really had to chew it. It wasn't really sweet either; it was still pretty bitter. It was hardly what you would now call a pleasurable experience.

The adventure begins
Rodolphe Lindt was a confectioner and an epicurean1 and made it his goal to create a chocolate that was mild and would melt in the mouth. Something you could enjoy. How he would get there he did not yet know back then. He bought an old factory hall with antiquated machines and began to experiment with the help of his brother, Auguste, a pharmacist like their father. 

A long journey
First the white coating on the chocolate had to be removed - crystallised fat which, although it was harmless, was not particularly appealing. When that was done, they went about refining the chocolate. More cocoa beans? Cocoa butter even? Nobody had tried so many variations up until then! He worked on the recipe, ran some ideas through his head, tinkered around, but no matter what he did, he did not get any closer to his goal. 

Chocolate, melt-in-the-mouth at last
But then came that Friday evening that was to revolutionise the world of chocolate. Lindt, close to giving up, left his factory without having finished his work -- and in particular, without switching off the machine. Did he forget because he was in a hurry? Or was it intentional? Perhaps he had some sort of hunch. We do not know. But the machine kept on working all weekend. When Lindt entered his factory the following Monday morning, his initial reaction was one of shock. But what he found in the stirrer tank was anything but a disaster.

The full aroma
Instead, it gleamed, and had a seductive aroma. When he tasted it, he was the very first person to experience how chocolate could develop its full aroma. And how it melts in the mouth! He called his achievement "chocolat fondant", melt-in-the-mouth chocolate.

column3:
Snickers Ice Cream Coffee Float Full Recipe:

Prep Time: 15 minutes 
Cook Time: 5 minutes  
Total Time: 20 minutes 
Number of Portions: 2  

Ingredients: 
2 tsp peanut butter, smooth 
2 tsp chocolate sauce 
2 (2.0 oz) Snickers Original Ice Cream Bar 
1 1/2 cups coffee, chilled 
1/4 cup seltzer water 
2 tbsp whipped topping 
2 tsp caramel sauce 

Directions: 
In a microwave, heat peanut butter for about 30 seconds or until runny.  

Drizzle peanut butter and chocolate sauce around the inside of each glass. 

Take one snickers ice cream bar and cut in half. Take the second snickers ice cream bar and quarter, reserve in freezer.  

Place one-half of Snickers Original Ice Cream Bar in each of the two 12-oz glasses.  

Pour 3/4 cup of coffee and 2 Tbsp seltzer into each glass. 

Take two quarters of the ice cream bar and place on skewers, repeat for a second skewer. 

Spoon whipped topping over the beverages, place on skewer across each glass, and garnish with caramel sauce drizzle. 

Tip: Keep it cool with a handful of crushed frozen coffee ice cubes.

column2: SNICKERS Peanut Butter Skillet Brownie
column3:
Layered with Snickers Peanut Brownie, these indulgent skillet brownies are a tasty dessert that’s sure to satisfy.

Prep Time: 10 minutes
Cook Time: 15 minutes
Total Time: 25 minutes
Makes: 12 servings (2 per skillet)

Ingredients:

2 bars (1.2 oz each) Snickers Peanut Brownie, divided
2/3 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp salt
1/4 cup canola oil
1/2 cup cocoa powder
1 cup granulated sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp chopped roasted peanuts
2 tbsp peanut butter

Instructions:

1.Preheat oven to 350˚F. Spray six mini (3.5-inch) cast-iron skillets with cooking spray; set aside. Chop 1 Snickers Peanut Brownie bar; set aside.
2.Stir together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.
3.In separate bowl, stir together oil and cocoa powder until blended. Stir in sugar. Stir in eggs and vanilla until blended. Stir in flour mixture; fold in chopped Snickers Peanut Brownie bar and peanuts.
4.Scoop 1/3 cup batter evenly into prepared skillets; smooth tops.
5.Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until only a few moist crumbs adhere to toothpick when inserted into center of brownie. Let cool slightly.
6.Cut remaining Snickers Peanut Brownie bar into 12 pieces. Place peanut butter in microwave-safe bowl; microwave for 20 to 30 seconds or until melted.
7.To serve, cut each brownie in half; top each brownie with piece of Snickers Peanut Brownie bar. Drizzle with melted peanut butter.

Tips:
•Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
•Alternatively, bake brownies in standard muffin cups or mini tart pans.

Prep Time: 20 minutes 

Cook Time: 5 minutes  

Total Time: 25 minutes  

Makes: 12 servings 

Ingredients: 


6 Snickers® Minis 

2 tbsp butter 

2 cups mini marshmallows 

1 tsp vanilla extract 

3 cups rice cereal 

6 oz dark chocolate chips, melted 

1 small tube white icing 

 

Instructions:
 

Chop all the Snickers ® Minis; set aside. 

Melt butter in large saucepan set over low heat; stir in marshmallows. Cook, stirring, for 3 to 5 minutes or until completely melted; stir in vanilla. Remove from heat.   

Immediately stir in cereal; fold in chopped Snickers® Minis. Scrape into bowl; let cool slightly. 

Scoop cereal into twelve 1/4-cup portions (reserve remaining mixture for another use). Using wet or lightly buttered hands, mold each portion into football shape. Let cool completely.  

Place melted chocolate in bowl. Using two forks, dip treats into melted chocolate, letting the excess drip back into bowl. Transfer to parchment paper–lined tray. Let stand until chocolate is set.  

Using icing, pipe laces on top of each football.  

 

Tip:  

• Substitute melted white chocolate for white icing if desired.  

• Dip cereal treats in milk or semi-sweet chocolate if preferred.

Prepared in a round pan, these Snickers blondies are cut into wedges, then simply decorated for an impressive fun holiday reindeer treat.

Cook Time: 20 minutes  

Total Time: 35 minutes

3/4 cup all-purpose flour 

1 tsp baking powder 

1/4 tsp salt 

1/3 cup butter 

1/4 cup peanut butter 

1 cup brown sugar 

1 egg 

2 tsp vanilla extract 

10 SNICKERS® Minis, chopped 

3 tbsp chopped peanuts 

1 tube brown or black gel icing

Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease 8-inch round baking pan. Line bottom with parchment paper; set aside. Whisk together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.

Bake on middle rack for 20 to 25 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out with just a few moist crumbs clinging to it. Let cool completely on rack. Carefully remove from pan; cut into 16 wedges.

column2: SNICKERS Crepe Cake
column3:
Layered with caramel, peanuts and whipped cream frosting, this show-stopping Snickers crepe cake will delight young and old alike. 


Prep Time: 20 minutes 
Cook Time: 20 minutes  
Total Time: 40 minutes (+ 20 minutes standing time) 
Serves: 14  

Ingredients:  

Crepes: 
1 cup 2% milk, at room temperature  
3/4 cup all-purpose flour, sifted 
2 tbsp butter, melted 
2 eggs, at room temperature 
1/4 tsp salt  
1 tbsp canola oil 

Crepe Cake: 
4 oz brick-style plain cream cheese, at room temperature and divided 
2 tbsp smooth peanut butter 
2 tbsp icing sugar 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
1/2 cup 35% heavy cream 
1/2 cup chopped toasted peanuts 
1/2 cup dulce de leche 
2 regular (1.86 oz each) Snickers Original, chopped 


Instructions:  

Crepes: In blender, mix together milk, flour, butter, eggs and salt; mix until smooth. Strain through fine-mesh sieve; let stand for at least 30 minutes (batter should be the consistency of thick cream; thin with a little water if needed). 

Heat 8-inch nonstick skillet set over medium heat; brush with some of the oil. Pour 3 tbsp batter into pan, swirling to coat bottom of pan. Cook for 60 to 90 seconds or until crepe begins to curl around edges. Flip over; cook for about 30 seconds or until set. Repeat with remaining batter, brushing pan with oil as needed. Transfer to parchment paper–lined baking sheet (you should have 12 crepes). Let cool completely. 

Crepe Cake: Using electric mixer, beat together 2 oz cream cheese and peanut butter until smooth; set aside.  

In separate bowl, beat remaining cream cheese, icing sugar and vanilla until smooth. In separate bowl, beat cream until stiff peaks form; beat into cream cheese and icing sugar mixture until light and fluffy. Set aside.  

Place one crepe on serving plate. Spread with 1/4 cup whipped cream mixture. Top with another crepe; layer with 1 tbsp peanut butter mixture. Sprinkle with 4 tsp peanuts. Top with another crepe; drizzle with 4 tsp dulce de leche and sprinkle with 1/4 cup chopped Snickers. Repeat layers 4 times. Refrigerate for 20 to 30 minutes or until set.  

Garnish with remaining whipped cream mixture, chopped Snickers and peanuts. Drizzle with remaining dulce de leche. Cut into 14 slices to serve. 

Tip: Drizzle melted dark chocolate over top and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt if desired.

2/3 cup butter, softened 

1/2 cup brown sugar 

1 egg  

1 1/3 cups all-purpose flour 

Pinch salt 

1/2 cup mini chocolate chips 

Fudgy Brownie Filling: 

6 tbsp melted butter, warm

1 egg

Using electric mixer on medium-high speed, beat butter with sugar for about 3 minutes or until light and fluffy. Beat in egg just until incorporated; beat in flour and salt. Stir in chocolate chips. Refrigerate for 15 minutes.   

Fudgy Brownie Filling: Meanwhile, stir together warm melted butter, sugar, cocoa powder and egg until well combined. Stir in flour and salt. Let stand at room temperature.  

Meanwhile, divide cookie dough evenly among mini muffin cups. Press evenly to cover bottom and up side of each cup. Cut Mini Snickers in half and place in center of each cup. Spoon brownie batter over Mini Snickers to fill each cup.  

Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until brownie is set in center and cookie is lightly golden brown around edges. Let cool slightly in pan on rack. 

Football Garnish: Place 1 Mini Snickers on each cup; press lightly to adhere. Let cool completely. Using royal icing, pipe “football laces” on each Snickers. Let stand until icing is set.  

Tips:   

• Prepared royal icing is available in squeeze tubes in the baking aisle.   

• Brookie Bites can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.

Prep Time: 10 minutes 

Cook Time: 25 minutes  

Total Time: 35 minutes  

Makes: 12 servings  

Ingredients:  
1 cup all-purpose flour 

1 tsp baking powder 

1/2 tsp salt 

1/2 cup unsalted butter 

1 cup brown sugar 

1 egg 

2 tsp vanilla extract 

12 Snickers Minis, chopped and divided 

1/2 cup prepared vanilla frosting 

1 oz pastel purple candy melts, melted 

1 oz pastel yellow candy melts, melted 

1 oz pastel blue candy melts, melted 

Instructions:  

 

Preheat oven to 350°F. Line greased 9-inch square baking pan with enough parchment paper to overhang edges. Whisk together flour, baking powder and salt; set aside.  

Melt butter in saucepan set over medium heat; stir in brown sugar. Remove from heat. Transfer to large bowl and let cool completely.  

Whisk in egg and vanilla. Stir in flour mixture until just combined. Fold in half of the chopped Snickers Minis. Scrape batter into prepared baking pan; smooth top.  

Bake on middle rack of oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until only a few moist crumbs adhere to toothpick inserted in center; let cool completely on rack. 

Remove from pan and remove parchment paper. Spread frosting over top. Using 2-inch egg-shaped cookie cutters, cut out 12 blondie eggs (reserve remaining blondies for another use).  

Decorate eggs with melted candy melts. Sprinkle with remaining chopped Snickers Minis. 

 

Tip: Alternatively, decorate with Easter sprinkles or pastel icing tubes instead of candy melts.

column2: SNICKERS Sweetheart Cupcakes
column3:
These Snickers chocolate cupcakes are an indulgent mini dessert that will please everyone on Valentine’s Day.  
Prep Time: 15 minutes 

Cook Time: 20 minutes  

Total Time: 35 minutes (+ 15 minutes chilling time) 

Makes: 16 servings  

Ingredients:  
16 Snickers Minis, divided 

2/3 cup all-purpose flour 

1/4 cup cocoa powder 

1/2 tsp baking powder 

1/4 tsp baking soda 

1/4 tsp salt 

1/2 cup granulated sugar 

1/3 cup buttermilk 

1/3 cup vegetable oil 

1 egg 

1 tsp vanilla extract 

2 tbsp chopped toasted peanuts 

Frosting: 

1/2 cup brick-style plain cream cheese, at room temperature 

1/3 cup smooth peanut butter 

1/2 cup icing sugar, sifted 

1/3 cup 35% heavy cream 

1/4 cup caramel sauce 

Instructions:  

Preheat oven to 350°F. Cut 8 Snickers Minis in half; set aside. Line 16 mini muffin cups with paper liners.  

Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda and salt. In separate bowl and using electric mixer, whisk together sugar, buttermilk, oil, egg and vanilla until well blended; stir into flour mixture.  
Scrape batter evenly into prepared muffin cups; insert reserved halved Snickers Mini into center of each cupcake. Smooth tops. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes or until tester inserted into center of cupcake comes out clean. Let cool completely on rack. 

Frosting: Beat together cream cheese and peanut butter until light and fluffy; beat in icing sugar. In separate bowl, beat cream until stiff peaks form; fold into peanut butter mixture. Refrigerate for 15 to 20 minutes or until chilled. Chop remaining Snickers Minis; set aside. 

Spoon peanut butter frosting into piping bag fitted with star tip. Pipe frosting over each cupcake; drizzle with caramel sauce. Sprinkle with toasted peanuts and reserved chopped Snickers Minis. 

Tip: For a buttermilk substitute, stir together 1/4 cup milk and 1 tsp vinegar; let stand for 5 minutes.

column3:
Perfect for celebrations big and small, this dessert tower is easy and fast to assemble and will wow any crowd!

Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 5 minutes
Total Time: 20 minutes 
Serves: 16

Ingredients

1/4 cup Milk Chocolate M&M’S Minis
10 M&M’S Vanilla Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches 
3/4 cup marshmallow spread
1 sparkler (optional)

Blowtorch

Instructions

1. Transfer Milk Chocolate M&M’S Minis to shallow bowl. Roll edges of M&M’S Vanilla Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches in M&M’S Minis. Freeze until ready to use.
2. Transfer marshmallow spread to piping bag fitted with large plain tip.
3. Working quickly, arrange 4 ice cream sandwiches side by side on a long platter. Pipe a layer of marshmallow spread. Using blowtorch, toast marshmallow spread.
4. Create a second layer on top using 3 ice cream sandwiches, followed by a layer of marshmallow spread; toast with blowtorch.
5. Create a third layer on top using 2 ice cream sandwiches, followed by a layer of marshmallow spread; toast with blowtorch.
6. Arrange remaining ice cream sandwich on top. Pipe remaining marshmallow spread on top and toast with blowtorch. 
7. Garnish with sparkler if desired; serve immediately.


Tip: Work quickly and keep the flame moving to avoid burning.

column2: M&M’S® Cookies and Cream Chip-Dipped Frozen Bonbons
column3:
These sweet and salty frozen M&M’S® Ice Cream Bonbons are perfect for sharing all summer long.


Prep Time: 10 minutes
Cook Time: 5 minutes
Total Time: 15 minutes (+ 1 hour 10 minutes standing time)
Makes: 12 bonbons

Ingredients: 

3 M&M’S® Cookies & Cream Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches 
6 oz dark chocolate, chopped 
1/4 cup crushed regular flavor potato chips

Instructions: 

1. Cut each M&M’S® Cookies & Cream Ice Cream Cookie Sandwich into 4 even pieces. Arrange on parchment paper–lined baking sheet, spacing evenly. Freeze for 30 to 60 minutes or until completely frozen and firm.
2. Meanwhile, arrange medium heat-safe bowl over medium saucepan of barely simmering water; add chocolate and heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until melted and smooth. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature. 
3. Using 2 forks, dip each ice cream sandwich quarter into melted chocolate, letting excess drip back into bowl. Return to baking sheet. Sprinkle tops with crushed potato chips, dividing evenly. Freeze until chocolate is hardened and set, about 30 minutes. Store in freezer until ready to serve.

Tips: 
• Substitute potato chips with your favorite salty snack: try crushed pretzel sticks, corn chips or salted peanuts.
• Substitute dark chocolate with milk chocolate or white chocolate if preferred.

Makes: 12 servings 

Ingredients: 

3 M&M’S® Vanilla Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches 
6 oz dark chocolate (at least 70% cacao), finely chopped 
1/4 cup mini marshmallows
1/4 cup roughly chopped almonds 
1 tbsp M&M’S® MINIS Milk Chocolate Candy

Instructions: 

1. Chop M&M’S® Vanilla Ice Cream Cookie Sandwiches into bite-size pieces. Arrange on parchment paper–lined baking sheet, spacing evenly. Freeze for 30 minutes or until completely frozen and firm. Keep frozen until needed. 
2. Line 13 x 9-inch baking dish with parchment paper so it overhangs edges. 
3. Transfer chocolate to medium heat-safe bowl set over medium saucepan of barely simmering water; heat for 4 to 5 minutes or until chocolate is melted and smooth. 
4. Pour melted chocolate into prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with chopped frozen ice cream cookie sandwiches, marshmallows, almonds and M&M’S® MINIS Milk Chocolate Candy. Freeze for 1 hour to 1 hour 30 minutes or until chocolate is set and frozen.  
5. Remove bark from baking dish and peel off parchment paper. Break into pieces and store in airtight container in freezer for up to 1 week.  

Tip:
