column2: Twix Doughboards with Maddie Mastro
TWIX CHEETOS FLAMIN' HOT Pumpkin Pies
column3:
Add these sweet and spicy mini pies to any menu to wow the crowd.  

Prep Time: 20 minutes 
Cook Time: 30 minutes  
Total Time: 50 minutes (+ 1 hour standing time) 
Makes: 12  

Ingredients: 
1 rolled refrigerator pie crust  
1/3 cup ground CHEETOS® Crunchy FLAMIN’ HOT® Cheese Flavored Snacks, divided 
1 egg yolk 
1/2 cup pumpkin purée 
2 tbsp packed brown sugar 
2 tbsp evaporated milk 
1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice 
1/2 tsp vanilla extract 
1/8 tsp salt 
8 Twix® Fun Size® Bars, divided 
1/4 cup heavy or whipping (35%) cream, whipped  
2 tbsp caramel sauce 

Instructions:  
1. Preheat oven to 350°F.  
2. Place pie crust on lightly floured work surface and sprinkle 2 tbsp ground CHEETOS® Crunchy FLAMIN’ HOT® Cheese Flavored Snacks evenly over crust. Using rolling pin, gently press into crust. Flip crust over and sprinkle 2 tbsp ground CHEETOS over crust. Using rolling pin, gently press into crust. 
3. Using 3-inch round cookie cutter, cut out 12 rounds, rerolling scraps as needed. Reserve any remaining scraps for another use.  
4. Fit pastry rounds into 12 mini muffin cups. Chill in refrigerator for 10 minutes to firm up pastry. Using fork, prick bottoms of pastry cups. Line pastry shells with mini muffin liners and fill with pie weights. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly golden.   
5. Remove weights and liners. Bake for 4 to 6 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and crisp. Let cool completely.  
6. In medium bowl, whisk together egg yolk, pumpkin purée, brown sugar, evaporated milk, pumpkin pie spice, vanilla and salt until blended.  
7. Chop 2 Twix® Fun Size® Bars and divide among pie shells. Pour in pumpkin purée mixture.  
8. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until filling is just set. Let cool completely. 
9. Cut remaining Twix in half diagonally. Just before serving, garnish each mini pie with small dollop of whipped cream, Twix half, remaining ground CHEETOS and drizzle of caramel sauce.  

Tip:  
•  Alternatively, use your favorite whipped topping if preferred.  

 
Nutrition Facts

Calories 160 
Fat 8g 
Saturated Fat 4g 
Cholesterol 25mg 
Sodium 135mg 
Carbohydrate 20g

column2: TWIX Christmas Trees Recipe
column3:
These Christmas tree treats make a festive addition to any holiday gathering.  

Prep Time: 45 minutes 
Cook Time: 5 minutes  
Total Time: 50 minutes (+ 20 minutes standing time)  
Makes: 10 

Ingredients: 
10 TWIX Minis 
3 tbsp butter 
3 cups mini marshmallows 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Liquid green food coloring 
4 cups rice cereal 
1/4 cup dulce de leche or caramel sauce 
2 tbsp candy sprinkles 

Instructions:  
Cut each TWIX Mini in half. Reserve 10 halves in small bowl; set aside. Chop remaining TWIX Minis; set aside.  

Melt butter in large saucepan set over low heat; stir in marshmallows for 3 to 5 minutes or until completely melted. Stir in vanilla, then stir in enough green food coloring for desired hue. Mix in rice cereal.  

Transfer cereal mixture to lightly greased work surface. Let cool slightly for 5 minutes; mix in reserved chopped TWIX Minis. With greased hands, shape into 11- x 7 -inch rectangle, about 1/2-inch thick. Let stand for about 15 minutes or until cooled and set. 

Cut bars in half lengthwise to make 2 long rectangles. Cut each rectangle evenly into 5 triangles (reserve end pieces for another use).  

Transfer dulce de leche to resealable plastic bag; cut off tip from bottom corner. Decorate each tree with drizzle of dulce de leche. Garnish with sprinkles. 

Use remaining dulce de leche to attach remaining halved TWIX Minis onto bottom of triangles to resemble tree trunks.  

Tips:  
• Substitute melted dark chocolate or store-bought icing tubes for dulce de leche if desired.  

• Use leftover cereal mixture to make holiday cereal pops.

column2: TWIX Ghosts Recipe
column3:
These quick and easy Twix Ghosts make a fun no-bake Halloween treat that everyone will love.  
 
Prep Time: 20 minutes 
Cook Time: 0 minutes  
Total Time: 20 minutes (+ 20 minutes standing time) 
Makes: 12 servings 
 
Ingredients: 
12 Twix Fun Size bars 
3 oz white chocolate chips, melted 
12 mini dark chocolate chips 
1 small tube brown or black icing 
 
Instructions:  
1. Spoon 2 tsp of melted white chocolate onto each Twix Fun Size bar, spreading to cover three-quarters of each bar. Place on parchment paper–lined baking sheet. 
2. With undipped portion of Twix at the bottom, place 1 chocolate chip about one-third of the way down from the top of the bar on the icing to resemble the ghost’s mouth.  
3. Let stand for about 5 minutes or until white chocolate is slightly set. Pipe 2 small dots of brown icing above each ghost’s mouth to resemble the eyes. Refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes or until white chocolate is completely set.  

Tips:  
• Substitute white candy melts for white chocolate chips if preferred.  
• Alternatively, use black icing or melted dark chocolate instead of chocolate chips to make the ghost’s mouth, letting the white chocolate set before piping.

column2: TWIX® S'mores Squares
column3:
A chocolate, caramel, & cookie take on a summer classic: TWIX® S'mores Squares.

Full Recipe:
 
Prep Time: 15 minutes 
Cook Time: 5 minutes  
Total Time: 20 minutes  
Makes: 12 servings 

Ingredients:  
1/4 cup butter 
4 cups mini marshmallows 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
20 whole rectangular graham wafer crackers, broken into 1-inch pieces 
2 Twix Original, chopped and divided 

Instructions:  
Melt butter in large saucepan set over low heat; stir in marshmallows for 3 to 5 minutes or until completely melted. Stir in vanilla. Remove from heat.   

Immediately stir in graham wafer pieces. Fold in half of the chopped Twix. Scrape into greased 9-inch square pan. Using wet hands or buttered spatula, spread evenly. Sprinkle remaining chopped Twix over top; press lightly to adhere to treats. Let cool completely.  

Tip:  For a toasted marshmallow variation, prepare squares in ovenproof baking dish or pan. Sprinkle enough mini marshmallows over top to cover completely. Using kitchen blow torch, toast marshmallows until golden brown, directing the flame about 2 inches above the topping, working quickly and keeping the flame moving to avoid burning. Sprinkle chopped Twix over top; let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Alternatively, preheat broiler. Broil on middle rack of oven for 2 to 3 minutes or until topping is golden brown.

column2: From Farm to Shelf: See How Triscuit is Made Simply
column3:
The journey of triscuit is simple. It begins in the heartland of America where local farmers and bakers create the delicious triscuit cracker, making it one great snack you can feel good about, no matter how you top it.
 
The delicious whole grain wheat is grown and harvested by passionate, generational family farmers. Some of these farmers have adopted regenerative agriculture practices that help protect the soil and optimize fertilizer use, such as using cover crops, implementing crop rotation, and practicing reduced tilling.
 
Triscuit also works with Michigan State University  https://www.canr.msu.edu/outreach/ Field to Market https://fieldtomarket.org/ and CO-OP Elevator https://www.coopelev.com/ to collect data from these farmers and advise them on ways to increase wheat yields, improve soil health, and reduce carbon emissions.

column2: Thick & Fluffy French Toast 😋
column3:
Take your Thick & Fluffy waffles to the next level with this delicious banana-nut French Toast recipe 😋

Recipe below:

Eggo Banana-Nut French Toast

Prep Time: 15 min
Total Time: 15 min
Servings: 1

Ingredients:
1 Eggo Thick & Fluffy Original waffles
1 egg, slightly beaten
1 tablespoon milk
1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 teaspoons butter or margarine
4 to 5 thick slices banana (about 1/3 small banana)
2 tablespoons chopped walnuts, toasted
Frozen non-dairy whipped topping, thawed (optional)
Powdered sugar (optional)
2 tablespoons maple syrup (optional)

Directions:

1. Place waffle on microwave-safe plate. Microwave, loosely covered, at high for 15 seconds or until just warm, turning waffle over after 10 seconds.

2. Meanwhile, in shallow dish beat together egg, milk and vanilla. Dip warm waffle in egg mixture, generously coating both sides. In medium, nonstick skillet heat butter over medium-high heat until melted. Add waffle to skillet. Cook for 2 to 4 minutes or until golden brown, turning once halfway through cooking time.

3. Place waffle on serving plate. Top with banana and walnuts. Spoon dollop of whipped topping on waffle (if desired). Sprinkle with powdered sugar (if desired). Drizzle with syrup (if desired).

Recipe below:

Goat Cheese, Apple and Bacon Canapés

Prep Time: 15 min
Total Time: 15 min
Servings: 2

Ingredients:
4 Eggo Minis Buttermilk pancakes
1 ounce goat cheese, cut into 4 slices
8 thin slices tart green apple (about 1/4 of small apple)
1 slice bacon, crisp-cooked and drained
2 teaspoons honey
Dash freshly ground black pepper

Directions:

1. Prepare Eggo Minis Buttermilk pancakes according to package directions. Arrange on serving plate.

2. Top pancakes with goat cheese and apple slices. Cut bacon into 4 pieces. Top each pancake stack with bacon piece. Drizzle with honey. Sprinkle with pepper. Serve immediately.

column2: Eggo Gingerbread People 🎄✨
column3:
Take out half the work with your holiday “cookies” this year!  

Recipe here:

Eggo Gingerbread People

Prep time: 20 min
Total time: 20 min
Servings: 6

Ingredients:
6 Kellogg’s® Eggo® Buttermilk pancakes
1/3 cup white chocolate morsels
1/3 cup squeezable seedless red raspberry spread or squeezable strawberry spread
Miniature candy-coated chocolate pieces (optional)
Strawberry slices (optional)

Directions

1. Prepare Kellogg's® Eggo® Buttermilk pancakes according to package directions. Use 3 1/2- to 4-inch cookie cutters to cut out desired shapes.

2. Place white chocolate morsels in small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave at medium-high (70% power) for 30 to 45 seconds or until smooth, stirring every 15 seconds.

3. Decorate pancake shapes by piping melted chocolate and raspberry preserves onto each. Garnish with candy pieces and/or strawberry slices (if desired).

column2: How to Make Orange Beef Stir Fry With Smucker's® Natural Orange Marmalade Fruit Spread
column3:
Create a delicious Orange Beef Stir Fry with our Smucker's® Natural Orange Marmalade Fruit Spread. #Smuckers #Pairings

Orange Beef Stir Fry
http://www.smuckers.com/recipes/quick-orange-beef-stir-fry-7354

INGREDIENTS

Crisco® Olive Oil No-Stick Cooking Spray
1/2 pound boneless beef sirloin, cut into thin strips
1 (12 oz.) bag frozen lightly seasoned Asian vegetable medley, thawed
2 teaspoons minced garlic
1/2 cup Smucker’s® Natural Orange Marmalade Fruit Spread
1/3 cup water
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 cups hot cooked brown rice

DIRECTIONS

COAT large skillet with no-stick cooking spray. Heat skillet over medium high heat. Stir-fry beef 2 to 3 minutes or until no longer pink. Remove from pan with slotted spoon. Keep warm.

ADD vegetables and garlic to skillet. Stir-fry over medium high heat 2 minutes. Add marmalade, water and soy sauce. Cook 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce slightly thickens.

ADD reserved beef. Cook until heated through. Serve immediately over rice.

column2: Tastykake & USO 100 Birthday Moments
column3:
In honor of our 100th birthday, Tastykake and the USO are delivering 100 Birthday Moments to our troops and their families throughout the year via the year-long 100 Birthday Moments initiative. The 100 Birthday Moments initiative supports the USO's ongoing Every Moment Counts campaign to rally Americans to honor and create moments that matter for our troops and their families. Every Moment Counts refers to the countless, every day moments -- from the front porch to the front lines -- that our troops and their families sacrifice due to their commitment and service to our country.

Among these every day moments that our troops and their families miss are birthdays. USO Centers worldwide help our troops celebrate these special moments by hosting monthly birthday parties, Military Branch Birthday Celebrations and special Birthday surprises. In honor of Tastykake's 100th Birthday and in support of Every Moment Counts, Tastykake has generously donated to the USO to help make these birthday moments even more special.  Photos and videos from every birthday moment will be captured and shared online so Americans can celebrate each of these 100 Birthday Moments with our troops and their families.

When Chazmo lands on Earth, he meets a lonely young girl searching for a friend. column2: Family Traditions with Fat Joe
White Castle Jalapeño Slider Stuffing with Fat Joe 🔥🌶️🍔
column3:
Fat Joe adds his “Sazón de Latino” flavor 🌶️ to his White Castle Jalapeño Slider Stuffing! Spice up the holidays! Link in bio

INGREDIENTS:
12 White Castle® Jalapeño Cheese Sliders
10 tablespoons Butter
1 cup diced celery
1 finely-diced Jalapeño Pepper
1 teaspoon sazón
1 teaspoon salt
1 & 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1 & 1/2 teaspoons cumin
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
3/4 cup turkey or chicken broth
2 eggs
1 cup shredded pepper jack cheese

 
Instructions:
 
Melt your butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add celery and jalapeño pepper and cook until soft.

HÄAGEN-DAZS X WEST COAST CUSTOMS | ICE CREAM-INSPIRED CONVERTIBLE
column3:
In celebration of our first-ever Big Game commercial, we’re bringing our “Not So Fast, Not So Furious” spot to life with a cross country journey dubbed “Dazs Drive.” Driving from Los Angeles to New Orleans in the ultimate ice cream vehicle, the journey is a slow spin on the traditional American road trip.

In partnership with West Coast Customs, the brands have meticulously crafted a 1963 Cadillac Series 62 convertible to feature a variety of brand-inspired design elements to encourage savoring each bite of Häagen-Dazs ice cream during the 1,900-mile journey to the Big Game.

When it comes to design, a stand-out facet of the vehicle is the “ice cream freezer” trunk customized to safely transport all the Häagen-Dazs the drive demands. The exterior features luxurious ice-cream-inspired custom paint and trim work in the Häagen-Dazs brand colors of burgundy and cream, while remaining authentic to the Cadillac design. The Cadillac’s hood is adorned with a customized Häagen-Dazs logo badge, which will also appear on the car’s steering wheel,  wheel caps and interior embroidery. The interior will not only boast custom cream leather seats and a burgundy leather dashboard, it will also include a custom Häagen-Dazs cone holder armrest, perfect for on the road enjoyment.

column2: The Back Forty: Ep. 3 Williams Lake
column3: With Revelstoke in the rearview mirror, the girls make their way up north into the Cariboo Region, which stretches from the Fraser Canyon to the Cariboo Mountains. This large area is home to many small but developing bike communities, such as 100 Miles House, Quesnel and Wells, and some larger better know ridding networks around Williams Lake. With such a large area to explore, the girls lost no time and started it all off at 100 Mile House.

column2: The Clif Couch: Clif Cycling Team
column3: In the words of Team CLIF® BAR cyclist Conor Mullervy, racing a Criterium is like “a Formula One on bicycles.” Crits aren’t just different from traditional cycling races, they also attract a different breed of rider. See for yourself as this tight-knit team kicks back on our CLIF® Couch.

column2: The Back Forty: Ep 2. Revelstoke
column3:
As the trip North continues, the girls board the Arrow Lake ferry, leaving the Kootenays behind them and make their way across to Revelstoke. This is where Casey grew up, and she was eager to show Micayla and Georgia around. 

To kick it all off, they head to Revelstoke Mountain Resort for some fast and flowy bike park laps.

One of the best areas in Revelstoke to shuttle is Boulder Mountain. There is a lot of variety in terrain and skill level. Anyone can find a trail to test their skills on. 

One of the most iconic rides in the region is Frisby Ridge. The girls pedaled up for sunset, which is a great time of day to really take in just how beautiful the scenery is. Just make sure to bring a headlamp for the ride down, as it gets dark quickly. 

Revelstoke was a real treat. Such unique riding and different zones to choose from. The girls wanted to keep exploring but had to keep moving up north. Next stop: Williams Lake!

column2: CLIF Bar Presents : In Good Company - Ohio River Cleanup
column3:
In Good Company Volunteers Get Down and Dirty to Clean Up An America River

Thousands of single-use plastic bottles. Hundreds of car and truck tires. Countless pieces of Styrofoam. Soccer balls and basketballs. Plastic toys. Barge line. 55-gallon drums. Oil cans. Scrap metal. Bedframes. Televisions. Two bowling balls and a hot tub. All told, 56,088 pounds of trash.

That was the haul by the volunteers of In Good Company who combed the banks of the Ohio River over two weeks in mid-October 2018, filling their large compostable trash bags and nearby river barges with the detritus of modern society—forgotten garbage often caked or buried in mud, some of it there for days or weeks, some of it for decades.

column3:
Oatmeal is only boring if you want it to be. With real, whole fruit and nourishing superfoods, gluten-free rolled oats transform into a one-step breakfast that brings long-lasting energy with minimal effort. 

Here we show you how to prepare the Apple + Cinnamon Oat Bowl. 

OVERVIEW
If an apple a day keeps the doctor away, imagine what our Apple + Cinnamon Oat Bowl can do. It packs 100% of your daily Vitamin C to keep your immune system sharp, plus cinnamon and cloves for fresh-baked flavor and cauliflower to keep you feeling light and energized.

Hot: 
STEP 1
Fill cup ¾ of the way with your preferred milk. Stir.

STEP 2
Empty into a pot or microwave-safe bowl.

STEP 3
For stovetop, cook over medium-high heat for 3-6 minutes. For microwave, heat 3-6 minutes, stirring halfway in between. Enjoy. 

Cold: 
STEP 1
Fill cup with your preferred milk ¾ of the way to the top. Stir.

STEP 2
Put lid back on and soak in the fridge overnight (6+ hours).

STEP 3
Stir and enjoy.

column2: Chik’n Strip Pot Pie 🥧
column3:
Do you ever just make one big pot of something and eat it for the whole week? Or is that just me… Try making your fave pot pie recipe, but vegetarian. Keep on reading for the recipe 👇
 #vegetarian #dinnerideas #easyrecipes

Chik’n Strip Pot Pie 🥧

Preheat your oven to 350 degrees.
Melt butter in a large cast iron pan, then add onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook until the carrots are tender (about 10
minutes).

Stir in MorningStar Farms Chik’n Strips, peas, thyme, and flour until the flour coats the Chik’n and vegetables.

Whisk in veggie broth and half-and-half. Cook until the sauce is thick.

Remove the cast iron pan from heat and add raw premade biscuit dough. Butter the tops of the biscuits and bake according to the package directions.

Garnish with parsley & enjoy!

10 oz Morningstar Farms Chik’N Strips
1/2 cup diced Onion
1/2 cup diced Celery
1/2 cup diced Carrots
1/2 cup Frozen Peas
16.3 oz Premade Biscuit Dough
1 tsp Dried Thyme
3 cups Vegetable Broth
2/3 cup Half & Half
1/4 cup All Purpose Flour
1/4 cup Unsalted Butter (set 1 Tablespoon aside for biscuits)
1 tbsp Dried or Fresh Parsley

Recipe below!

MorningStar Farms® Stuffed Peppers
Total Yield: 6 servings
PREP TIME: 15 MINUTES
TOTAL TIME: 45 MINUTES

1 Value pack (32oz) MorningStar Farms Grillers® Crumbles
2 Tbsp Vegetable Oil
16 oz bell pepper, (Green or Red 3, cut in half)
1/2 cup chopped onion
1 tsp minced garlic
1/2 cup cooked jasmine rice
14.5 oz can diced tomatoes
1 1/2 cup vegetable broth
1 Tbsp tomato paste
2 tsp Italian seasoning
1/2 tsp ground black pepper
4 Tbsp feta cheese (optional)

Cooking directions

1. In a large nonstick skillet, cook onion and garlic in vegetable oil on low to medium heat until tender. Add Grillers® Crumbles, diced tomatoes, 1 cup vegetable broth, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, and black pepper. Simmer on low for 8-10 minutes until tomatoes soften.

2. While simmering, remove the stems and seeds from the peppers, place the peppers in a 13x9 baking dish, and preheat the oven to 380°F. Remove the crumble mixture from the heat, stir in the rice, and fill each pepper with 1 heaping cup of the mixture.

3. Add the remaining 1/2 cup vegetable broth to the baking dish. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes until the peppers are tender. Remove the foil, add cheese (optional), and bake for 3 more minutes. Serve and enjoy!

column2: Smothered Chik'n Potatoes
column3:
‘Tis the season for indulgent meals… you deserve these smothered chik’n potatoes ❤️

Find the recipe below!

Morningstar Farms® Smothered Chik'n Potatoes

Total Yield: 4 servings
Prep Time: 10 Minutes
Total Time: 20 Minutes
 
2 cups Morningstar® Farms Chik'n Strips
4 cups frozen Potato Rounds 
1 Tbsp Unsalted Butter 
1 Tbsp All-purpose Flour
1 tsp Dried Thyme
1 Tbsp Garlic, minced
2 cups Colby Jack Cheese
1 cup frozen Broccoli Cuts 
2 cups Half & Half
1 tsp Salt
1/4 tsp Ground Black Pepper

Prep Method

Thaw and dice Morningstar Farms Chik’n Strips. In a large non-stick skillet, cook with butter and garlic as per package directions. Add flour, thyme, pepper, and salt. Cook on low until it forms a paste. Add half & half, 1 cup of cheese, and frozen broccoli. Stir and cook on low for 5 minutes until thickened. Set aside.

Preheat the oven according to the package instructions. Bake the potato rounds until golden brown. Sprinkle with 1 cup of Colby jack cheese. Scoop the Chik’n mixture on top. Bake for an additional 5 minutes. Serve hot and enjoy! Add parsley.

column2: Veggie Chorizo Southwest Pie​
column3:
We just know everyone will be fighting for the last slice of this veggie Chorizo Southwest Pie 😋 Recipe below! #vegetarian #chorizo #pie #dinnerideas #shorts

Morningstar Farms® Chorizo Southwest Pie 

Total Yield: 6 servings 
PREP TIME: 10 MINUTES 
TOTAL TIME: 25 MINUTES 

--

1 bag Morningstar® Farms Chorizo Crumbles™ 
1 cup Can Corn (drained) 
1 cup can Black Beans (drained) 
1 cup Pepper & Onion Mix (frozen, fajita mix) 
1 tsp minced Garlic 
1/4 tsp Ground Cumin 
1 Tbsp Cilantro, chopped 
1 1/2 cup Enchilada Sauce 
1 1/2 cup Shredded Cheddar (cheese) 
1 box Corn Muffin Mix (8.5oz box) 
2 Tbsp unsalted Butter 

Prep Method 

In a bowl, combine Morningstar® Farms Chorizo Crumbles™, corn, black beans, onion and pepper mix, garlic, cilantro, and cumin. Heat a non-stick pan with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil on medium. Cook the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring in the enchilada sauce. Set aside. 

Preheat the oven according to the corn muffin mix instructions. Spray a 13x9 pan. Layer the chorizo mix and shredded cheddar cheese, followed by the corn muffin mix. Spread evenly and bake. 

Once baked, spread 2 tablespoons of butter on top. Serve immediately. Enjoy!

column2: French's Jalapeño Pretzel Dog
column3:
This delicious and spicy appetizer will be an instant crowd favorite!
http://bit.ly/2y2wCj2

Ingredients
1 can refrigerated pizza dough, (11 oz.) 
12 hot dogs 
3 Tbsp. baking soda 
water 
5 oz. French's™ Crispy Jalapeños, crushed 
French's Classic Yellow Mustard 
 
Directions

PREHEAT oven to 400°F. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick spray.
BRING a large pot of water to a boil. Add hot dogs and boil for 3 minutes. Once hot dogs are cooked, allow to cool enough to handle.
WHILE cooking hot dogs, roll out pizza dough and cut into 12 - 1/2 inch strips lengthwise. (There may be dough leftover; twist into bread sticks and bake) Spread crushed Jalapeños in pie dish. 
LADLE one cup of the boiling water from the hot dogs into a bowl big enough to fit hot dogs. Add baking soda and stir until dissolved.
WRAP each hot dog with one strip of dough, twisting it around and back. Leave a 1/2 inch space at each end. When hot dogs are wrapped, carefully dip each into water mixture being sure to cover. 
GENTLY roll each hot dog in crushed Jalapeños and place on baking sheet. Bake for 10 minutes. Bake until browned on top. Serve with French's Classic Yellow Mustard.

column2: French's Crunchy Jalapeño Mac & Cheese
column3:
Kick your mac & cheese up a notch with this super cheesy recipe with the perfect blend of spice and crunch!

http://bit.ly/2feksvz

Ingredients
1 box (7 1/4 ounces) macaroni and cheese dinner mix 
1/4 cup butter 
1/2 cup milk, divided 
1/2 tsp. chili powder 
1/2 tsp. paprika 
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 
1 1/2 cups shredded Italian cheese blend, divided 
1 cup FRENCH'S™ Crispy Jalapeños 

Directions 
PREHEAT oven to 350°F. Grease 8 - 4 oz. ramekins and place on baking sheet.
COOK macaroni and cheese according to package. 
STIR in the additional 1/4 cup milk, chili powder and paprika while the macaroni is still hot. Add cheddar cheese and 1 cup Italian cheese blend and continue to stir, over low heat, until melted. Take off heat and mix in half the Jalapeños.
FILL ramekins. 
TOP each with remaining Italian cheese blend and Crispy Jalapeños. Bake in oven 10 minutes until cheese melts.


Tips
Double up the recipe for a party.

column2: French’s Bacon Cheeseburger Mac & Cheese | We  Promise Great Taste
column3:
The hardest part of eating our Bacon Cheeseburger Mac & Cheese? Putting down your fork!
-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/2kyaK7j

Ingredients
1/2 lb. bacon
1 lb. lean ground beef
salt & pepper, to taste
1/4 cup finely chopped onion
2 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Tomato Ketchup
1 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Classic Yellow® Mustard
4 cups whole milk
3/4 lb. large elbow macaroni
1 cup chopped American cheese
3 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided

Directions
PREHEAT oven to 400°F.
COOK bacon in a cast iron skillet until crispy. Then remove the bacon and set aside. Reserve 1 teaspoon of bacon fat in the pan. (Chop the bacon once it’s cooled.)
IN THE SAME PAN, cook beef until browned. Break apart while cooking and add salt and pepper.
ONCE the beef is browned, add onion and continue cooking until the onions are translucent, then add ketchup and mustard. Stir until slightly thickened. Set aside, but keep in the skillet.
SIMMER milk in a large pot, then add pasta and some salt, and cook until slightly underdone. Add American cheese and 2 cups of the cheddar cheese and stir until thick and creamy.
POUR the macaroni and cheese over the beef in the cast iron skillet and top with the extra shredded cheese. Bake 15-20 minutes, or until bubbly, then top with chopped bacon. Enjoy.

column2: French’s Cheeseburger Turnovers | We Promise Great  Taste
column3:
Love cheeseburgers? Of course you do! Try this tasty take.
-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/2kx7CwJ

Ingredients
3/4 lb. ground beef salt and pepper to taste
1 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Classic Yellow® Mustard
3 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Tomato Ketchup
2 sheets puff pastry dough
18 slices American cheese
1/4 cup red onion, finely chopped
18 hamburger pickle rounds
1 egg, beaten
1 tsp. sesame seeds

Directions
PREHEAT oven to 400°F/200°C and line a sheet tray with parchment paper.
BROWN the beef in a nonstick or cast iron pan, and season with salt and pepper.
Once the beef is cooked, drain out excess fat and stir in the ketchup and mustard. Cook and stir for 30 seconds to 1 minute, then remove from heat.
ROLL out the dough on a lightly floured surface, and cut into 3-inch squares.
LAYER a piece of American cheese (folded in half to create a triangle) on each of the dough squares, add some of the beef mixture, a sprinkle of red onions, and a pickle.
DIP a pastry brush (or your finger) into the beaten egg and trace around the edge of the dough. Fold the dough into a triangle and pinch the sides tightly. Lightly brush the top of the turnover with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
PLACE on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
SERVE with ketchup and mustard for dipping. Enjoy!

column2: Cheese Stuffed Slow Cooker Jalapeño Meatballs | We  Promise Great Taste
column3:
Spice up your Meatballs with our Crispy Jalapeños.
-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/2ky3Grk

Ingredients
5 oz. FRENCH'S™ Crispy Jalapeños
1 lb. ground beef
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp. onion powder
1 tsp. garlic powder
salt and pepper to taste
1 egg
3 oz. Jack cheese, cubed
2 1/2 cups salsa
vegetable oil

Directions
COMBINE all ingredients except the cheese, salsa, and vegetable oil. Stir until fully incorporated.
GRAB about a golf ball-sized amount of the ground beef mixture and slightly flatten it in your palm. Take 1 cube of cheese, place it in the the middle, and press the beef around it so the cheese is fully covered and in the center of the meatball.
HEAT a thin layer of vegetable oil in a pan over medium to medium-high heat.
Brown the meatballs. Rotate them a few times to brown several sides.
POUR 1 cup of salsa in the bottom of the slow cooker and place the meatballs on top. Cover meatballs with the remaining salsa and cook on high for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
TOP with a dollop of sour cream and cilantro if desired. Enjoy.

column2: French’s Jalapeño Breaded Chicken Sliders | We  Promise Great Taste
column3:
Spice-up your chicken sliders with the perfect combination of spice and crunch.
-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/2kyenu8

Ingredients
3/4 cup FRENCH'STM Crispy Jalapeños, chopped
2 boneless, skinless chicken breast
2 tsp. seasoned salt
1 tsp. ground pepper
2 eggs
1/2 cup flour
1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs
8 slider buns
lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
Ranch dressing
vegetable oil for frying

Directions
FINELY chop the French’s Crispy Jalapeños. Mix with breadcrumbs and set aside.
SPLIT chicken breasts in half down the side, then cut each breast into 4 pieces.
Pound out and rub with seasoned salt and pepper.
DREDGE the pieces of chicken in flour, then dip in egg, and then cover with the breadcrumb mixture.
FRY chicken pieces in about a 1⁄2-inch of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook until golden brown. (Tip: you can place the finished pieces in the oven to keep warm while preparing the rest!)
SERVE on a slider bun with lettuce, tomato, Crispy Jalapeños, and ranch dressing.

column3:
These Cheeseburger Stuffed Peppers are perfect for any occasion, but especially clutch as an easy weeknight meal.
-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/2fQBQE5 

Ingredients
8 medium bell peppers
2 1/2 lbs. ground beef, cooked and drained or 4 cups cooked ground beef 
3 cups shredded American or Cheddar cheese, divided 
1 1/2 cups French’s® Tomato Ketchup 
1/2 cup French’s® Classic Yellow Mustard 
3 Tbsp. French’s® Classic Worcestershire Sauce 
3 Tbsp. dill pickle relish 
1 1/2 cups French’s™ Crispy Jalapeños 

Directions
HEAT oven to 350°F. Leaving stems on the peppers, slice peppers lengthwise, remove seeds and membranes. Add peppers to large pot of boiling water; simmer 5 minutes until just tender. Drain peppers, cut side down, on paper towels.
COOK ground beef and drain. Mix meat with 2 cups cheese, Ketchup, Mustard, Worcestershire, relish and 1 cup Crispy Jalapeños.
SPOON meat mixture into peppers, dividing evenly. Place peppers into 2-qt. baking dish. 
BAKE 25 minutes until peppers are hot. Sprinkle tops of peppers with remaining cheese and Jalapeños and bake 5 minutes more until cheese melts.

Ingredients:
4 lbs. pork spareribs 
2/3 cup FRENCH'S® Tomato Ketchup 
1/2 cup maple syrup 
1/4 cup FRENCH'S ® Classic Worcestershire Sauce 
3 Tbsp. FRENCH'S® Classic Yellow® Mustard 
2 cloves garlic, chopped

Directions:
PREHEAT oven to 300°F. Place ribs in baking pan, cover and bake for 2 hours or until very tender.

1 lb. ground beef

Ingredients
6 cups prepared mashed potatoes 
12 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled 
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese 
2 cups FRENCH'S® Crispy Fried Onions 

Directions
PREHEAT oven to 350°F. Layer half of the potatoes in an 8-inch square baking dish, sprinkle with half the bacon, 1 cup cheese and 1 cup Crispy Fried Onions. Top with remaining potatoes.
BAKE 20 minutes or until hot. Top with remaining bacon, cheese and Crispy Fried Onions. Bake 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

column2: French's Thanksgiving Turkey Sandwich  | We Promise Great Taste
column3:

-RECIPE- http://bit.ly/2c8MxF1

Ingredients
3/4 cup cranberry sauce 
2/3 cup FRENCH'S® Classic Yellow® Mustard 
1/2 cup FRENCH'S® Tomato Ketchup 
1/2 cup brown sugar 
4 cups shredded cooked turkey 
3/4 cup FRENCH'S® Crispy Fried Onions 
1 1/2 cups hot prepared stuffing 
1 1/2 cups hot mashed potatoes 
6 sandwich buns or rolls 

Directions
COMBINE cranberry sauce, Mustard, Ketchup and brown sugar in medium saucepan. Stir in turkey.
COOK over medium heat 8 minutes or until hot, stirring occasionally. Stir in Onions.
ARRANGE stuffing and potatoes on bottom of buns. Top with turkey, additional Onions and bun tops.

Tips
Turkey can be served in wraps or over hot potatoes or stuffing.

column3:
@lifewithtuyen Easy High Protein Fluffy Pancakes ft. Silk Original Protein!! Ft. Homemade Buttermilk! Esp when you still want something nutritious and yummy in the mornings.  

Easy High Protein Fluffy Pancakes Recipe:

Start your day with a delightful and nutritious twist on the classic pancake. These Easy High Protein Fluffy Pancakes, featuring homemade buttermilk, are not just delicious but also packed with nutrition. Whether you're looking for a quick breakfast or a fun brunch item, these pancakes will satisfy your cravings while keeping your health in mind.

To make these pancakes, you'll need simple ingredients and a few quick steps. Begin by gathering your components: flour, eggs, milk, baking powder, and of course, high protein sources like protein powder or Greek yogurt to elevate the nutritional value. Blend these together until you have a smooth batter.

Once your batter is ready, heat a non-stick skillet and pour in the batter, watching as it transforms into fluffy pancakes that are sure to impress. Cook until golden brown on both sides, and serve warm. The addition of buttermilk gives these pancakes a rich flavor and soft texture that is simply irresistible.

Perfect for busy mornings when you want something tasty yet nutritious, these pancakes are easy to customize with your favorite toppings, such as fresh fruits, nut butter, or a drizzle of maple syrup. Enjoy a guilt-free indulgence that helps fuel your day!

Why not try making these pancakes this weekend? Share your pancake creations and tag #SilkRecipes to join the community and showcase your culinary skills!

column2: Firefighters Cut Open a Car to Rescue a Woman Trapped Inside
column3:
Firefighters from Springfield, NJ were able to rescue a car accident victim who was trapped inside her vehicle. Thanks to lifesaving extrication tools donated to the department by the Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation, the first responders were able to quickly and safely free the woman and get her the care she needed. There were no life-threatening injuries, and the newly acquired equipment donation had a major impact on the operation that day. 

At Firehouse Subs, subs are only part of our story. A portion of your purchase in 2022 at all US Firehouse Subs locations goes to the Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation, to be used to provide lifesaving equipment to first responders.

Since the Foundation started, it has granted over $65 million to provide equipment, training, and support to hometown heroes.

The need for first responder equipment is still great. But it's the stories like this that remind us every donation has the power to change lives.

column2: Breyers Thanksgiving Make Ahead Apple Ice Cream Pie
column3:
This is a great one that you can make ahead of time and freeze until the holiday! It’s delicious and will be one less thing you have to stress about on the big day! 

INGREDIENTS
1 tub Breyers Natural Vanilla Ice Cream
Whipped cream, for serving 
1 Granny Smith Apple, thinly sliced  

Crust:
18-20 graham crackers 
1 stick of butter, melted
1/3 cup sugar
1/2 tsp salt 

Filling:
5 Granny Smith apples, peeled & diced 
4 tbsp butter 
1/3 cup light brown sugar
2 tsp cinnamon 

RECIPE
1. Prepare the apple filling. In a pot over medium heat, melt butter and add diced apples. Sauté and soften for 1-2 minutes then add 1/3 cup of brown sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon. Turn the heat to low and stir occasionally. Cook until the apples have softened and it is no longer runny. Once cooked, place in a container and refrigerate to chill for a minimum of one hour (best overnight). 
2. Prepare the graham cracker crust. Crush the graham crackers in a bag with a rolling pin or in a food processor. Add the crushed crackers to a bowl with melted butter and sugar. Stir to combine. 
3. Add the graham cracker mix into a pie dish. Spread evenly and press down to pack and form a crust. Once you’ve made a crust, set the pie dish inside the freezer to harden and cool for about 5 minutes. Remove the ice cream from the freezer while you wait. 
4. Remove the pie dish from the freezer and add 5-6 large scoops of ice cream onto the crust. Press down on the ice cream with a spoon to smooth and spread evenly across the crust. 
5. Top the ice cream with the apple filling and spread evenly. 
6. Add another layer of 5-6 scoops of ice cream along the top of the pie. Press down on the ice cream with a spoon to spread evenly and then smooth the top with a knife. 
7. Top with thin apple slices and garnish with a dash of cinnamon. Place in the freezer to freeze for at least 4 hours or until frozen (best overnight). 
8. To serve, remove from the freezer and sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes before slicing.

column2: Breyers Thanksgiving No-Bake Pumpkin Gingersnap Squares #breyers #thanksgivingrecipes #recipe
column3:
These no bake Pumpkin Gingersnap Ice Cream Squares are truly so delicious and will have your guests asking for more. See Recipe Below: 

INGREDIENTS:
1 cup graham cracker crumbs
1 cup gingersnaps crumbs
1/2 cup butter, melted
2 cups pumpkin puree
1/4 cup granulated sugar
2 tsp. pumpkin pie spice
1 container (1.5 qt.) Breyers® Natural Vanilla Ice Cream, softened
1 can whipped cream

RECIPE:
1) Combine graham cracker and gingersnaps crumbs and butter in large bowl with a fork until blended.
2) Press crumb mixture into 13 x 9-inch baking dish, reserving 1/4 cup crumbs for garnish. Chill until firm, about 30 minutes.
3) Combine pumpkin, sugar and pumpkin pie spice in large bowl. Fold in softened Breyers® Natural Vanilla Ice Cream until well mixed. Spoon into chilled crust. 
4) Freeze until firm, about 4 hours or overnight.

To serve: cut into squares. Top squares with whipped cream and sprinkle with reserved 1/4 cup crumbs.

column2: Breyers Thanksgiving Pumpkin Caramel Ice Cream Pie
column3:
Move over pumpkin pie… this Pumpkin Caramel Ice Cream Pie is coming for your throne. Made with our delicious vanilla ice cream, a homemade pumpkin caramel sauce, and a super simple, 2 ingredients crust, this may turn into your family’s new favorite dessert tradition. 

INGREDIENTS:
1 tub Breyers vanilla ice cream
5 tablespoons melted butter
12.5 oz cinnamon graham crackers
Pumpkin Caramel sauce:
1/4 cup olive oil
1/4 cup maple syrup
2 teaspoons pumpkin puree
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon or pumpkin pie spice


RECIPE:
1) Place cinnamon crackers in a food processor or blender with the melted butter and blend until no large pieces remain. 
2) Press into a pie dish (reserving a couple tablespoons of crumbs for topping) and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit until lightly browned, around 10 minutes. 
3) Remove from the oven and, once cooled, fill with the vanilla ice cream (you can let the ice cream sit on the counter at room temp for a couple minutes to soften). 
4) Drizzle on a few tablespoons of the caramel sauce, adding swirls if desired, then sprinkle on the cookie crumbs and freeze until ready to serve. Enjoy!

column2: Homemade Snack Wraps 🍗🌯
column3:
WE HAVE SNACK WRAPS AT HOME 🗣️
 
FOR THE CHICKEN:
- 16 oz chicken tenders (about 8 tenders)
- Frying oil 
 
BREADING INGREDIENTS:
- 2 cups AP flour
- 1/2 cup cornstarch
- 3 tsp smoked paprika 
- 3 tsp chili powder
- 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp salt 
- fresh cracked pepper
 
MARINADE INGREDIENTS:
- 1 oz packet Hidden Valley Ranch Dip Mix 
- Enough buttermilk to cover chicken, about 4 cups 
- 1 tsp salt 
 
EVERYTHING ELSE:
- 7 or 8 inch flour tortillas
- 8 green leaf lettuce leaves, washed
- freshly grated sharp cheddar cheese
- Hidden Valley Ranch Dressing
 
Instructions:
🍗 In a large bowl, combine chicken tenders and marinade ingredients.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight. 
 
🍗 Heat oil in a frying pan over Medium to Medium High Heat.  Meanwhile, prepare a cooling rack with a lined baking sheet underneath.  Also, combine all breading ingredients in a separate shallow pan.  
 
🍗 Once oil is just under 350 degrees fahrenheit, dredge chicken in breading mixture.  Make sure each tender is well coated.  
 
🍗 Carefully place each tender in hot oil.  Cook chicken tenders on each side for about 3 minutes, in batches to not overcrowd the pan.  Chicken tenders are done when the internal temperature of each reaches 165 degrees fahrenheit.  Once done, place chicken on prepared cooling rack.
 
🍗 Next, heat tortillas on stovetop or in microwave (about 30 seconds) until pliable. 
 
🍗 Assemble Snack Wraps in this order: heated tortilla, drizzle of Hidden Valley Ranch, lettuce, another drizzle of Hidden Valley Ranch, cheese, and a chicken tender.  Wrap and eat!

Cooking with Chef Katy: QDOBA's Chicken Tortilla Soup
column3:
Learn to make QDOBA’s Chicken Tortilla Soup from our very own Chef Katy in just 7 EASY steps! 💚🧡
Ingredients: 
- Leftover Cooked Chicken
- 🔥 Fire Roasted Diced Tomatoes- 1 can
- Olive or Vegetable Oil
- 1 Onion 
- 2 Dried Peppers (Pasilla Negra or Pasilla Ancho Chile)
- 5 garlic cloves
- 8 cups broth, stock, or water
- 1 tsp Mexican Oregano (optional)
- Salt
🥑 Garnishes: Shredded Cheese, Sour Cream, Lime Wedges, Guacamole or Sliced Avocado, Tortilla Chips 

Step 1: Open can of tomato and place into a blender.
Step 2: Slice onions and set aside.  Mince garlic and set aside.  Remove stems from chiles and cut chiles into roughly 1-inch pieces. 
Step 3: Add 1 tbsp of oil to a stockpot and set heat to medium-high.  Add onion and chiles.  Cook, stirring frequently until onion turns golden brown and chiles are aromatic and softened.  Add garlic and stir for 1 more minute.  Transfer onions and chile to the blender.  
Step 4: Add half of the chicken stock, Mexican Oregano, and a pinch of salt to the blender.  Blend until completely smooth.  
Step 5: Return pot to the stove and set over medium heat.  Add 2 more tbsp oil.  Use a medium-mesh strainer to strain the puree directly to the pan.  
Step 6: Bring to a simmer and stir puree frequently to avoid burning or sticking to the pan.  Add the remaining 4 cups of stock and chicken to the pan and bring to a simmer.  Taste and add more salt if needed.  
Step 7: Ladle soup into bowls and top with broken tortilla chips and your favorite garnishes. 

Enjoy! 😋

column3:
you’re gonna wanna try this and you’re not gonna regret it— Sweet Lime & Sea Salt margarita!​

to make your own, simply gather:​
1 ½ oz blanco tequila​
1/2 oz triple sec​
1 oz agave​
3/4 oz lime juice​
2 cups TOSTITOS® Sweet Lime & Sea Salt SCOOPS!®​
2 tsp sea salt​
2 tsp lime zest​
1 tsp sugar​

​combine chips, salt, and lime zest into bowl of food processor. process into a coarse powder. dip rim of glass into small pool of agave, then into the rimmer mixture. combine blanco tequila, triple sec, agave, and lime juice in the glass, and garnish with lime. Enjoy!​

column2: #Upcycling- Soup Can Planters and Pencil holder!
Vegan Southwest Egg Rolls
column3:
Vegan Southwest Egg Rolls!​⁣⁣
⁣⁣
This vegan version of a childhood favorite evokes some great memories for @blkandvegan! “They bring me back to times my mother and I would go on 'mommy-daughter dates' and we would always order them alongside my Shirley Temple (oh, the joys of being a kid)! These egg rolls are close to my heart ♥️!"​⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Ingredients:⁣⁣
1 cup vegan chicken of choice ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
1 can Amy’s Black Bean Vegetable Soup ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
1 package vegan egg roll wrappers ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
½ cup bell peppers, diced ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
¼ red onion, diced ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
1-2 green onions, diced ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Handful spinach, chopped ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
½ tsp smoked paprika ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Salt to taste ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
A squeeze of lime juice (optional) ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
2 Tbsp vegan milk ⁣⁣
Dipping Sauce: Vegan Ranch ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
-⁣⁣
⁣⁣
-⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Directions: ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Begin by draining your Amy’s Black Bean Soup for 10 minutes to get rid of excess liquid. ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Cook your vegan chicken according to package directions. ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Next, add smoked paprika, bell peppers, red onions, green onions, spinach, salt and, lime juice. Cook for 8 minutes on medium-high heat, stirring periodically. Set aside. ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Lay out egg roll wrapper, brush the edges with almond milk and place 2 tbsp of southwest mixture in the right -center of the wrapper. ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Gently fold your wrapper over the mixture, tuck in the sides, brush the inside of the wrapper with almond milk to help secure the wrapping, and roll tightly (see video for reference). ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
Air fry for 8-10 minutes at 380ºF and enjoy! ⁣⁣
⁣⁣

column2: Buffalo Chicken Bombs
column3:
Every bite is a buffalo flavored party in your mouth.
-RECIPE- https://www.franksredhot.com/recipes/buffalo-chicken-bombs

Ingredients
1 cup rotisserie chicken, chopped
3/4 cup FRANK'S RedHot Buffalo Wings® Sauce, plus extra for garnish
1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/4 cup green onion, chopped
1 1/2 lbs. refrigerated pizza dough
2 Tbsp. olive oil [or vegetable oil]
3 Tbsp. blue cheese crumbles
blue cheese dressing, for dipping

Directions
PREHEAT oven to 425ºF/220ºC.
MIX the chicken with Frank’s RedHot Buffalo Wings Sauce, green onion, and cheese.
GENTLY flatten a small piece of dough in your palm (slightly smaller than a golf ball) and put approximately 1 teaspoon of the chicken mixture into the dough.
Pinch the dough together to form an enclosed ball and place on a nonstick baking sheets (or line your baking sheets with parchment paper if they’re not non-stick).
BRUSH bombs with oil and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
TOP with blue cheese crumbles and drizzle with additional Frank’s RedHot Buffalo Wings Sauce. Serve with blue cheese dressing, celery sticks, and carrots. Enjoy!

column2: Quick ‘N’ Easy Frank’s RedHot Tacos
column3:
Taco Tuesday just got extended into Wednesday … and Thursday … and Friday-Monday. Load up the tortillas and pour on the Frank’s RedHot. 
-RECIPE- https://www.franksredhot.com/recipes/quick-n-easy-tacos

Ingredients
1 lb. ground beef 
1 cup salsa 
1/4 cup any flavor FRANK'S RedHot® Original Cayenne Pepper Sauce 
2 tsp. ground chili powder 
8 taco shells, heated 
1 Garnish: chopped tomatoes, shredded lettuce, sliced olives, sour cream or shredded cheese 

Directions
COOK beef in skillet over medium-high heat 5 min. or until browned, stirring to separate meat; drain.
STIR in salsa, Frank's RedHot Sauce and chili powder. Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook 5 min., stirring often.
SPOON meat mixture into taco shells. Garnish as desired. Splash on more sauce to taste.

column3:
If you’re craving something zesty and refreshing, this Pistachio Tabouli is calling your name 🌿🥒✨ See the full recipe below ⬇️​
​
Ingredients:​
• 2 cups cooked couscous​
• 1 cup cucumber, diced small​
• 1/2 cup tomato, diced small​
• 1/4 cup Italian parsley, finely chopped​
• 1/4 cup fresh mint, finely chopped​
• 1 bag of Wonderful Pistachios No Shells Unsalted​
• 2 @wonderfulseedlesslemons, juiced​
• 3 tbsp olive oil​
• 1/2 tsp kosher salt​
• 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper​
​
How to:​
Prepare couscous according to package instructions and let cool.​
In a large bowl, combine couscous, cucumber, tomato, parsley, mint, and a bag of Wonderful Pistachios No Shells Unsalted.​
Finish with fresh lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.​
Toss gently, taste, and adjust as needed. Serve chilled or at room temp.​
​

Fold in dark chocolate chips and chopped pistachios. ​
Use cookie scoop or ice cream scoop to drop balls of dough onto lined baking pan. ​

Bake for 10-12 minutes or until middle of cookies are set. ​

column2: Sweet Cinnamon Pistachio Snickerdoodle Cookies 🍪😋
column3:
Snickerdoodle season just got a major upgrade ✨ Soft cinnamon-sugar cookies loaded with crushed Wonderful Pistachios Sweet Cinnamon No Shells, finished with fluffy buttercream on top. Warm, sweet, and a little nutty. Full recipe below 🍪:
 
Cookie Dough: 
2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
¼ tsp ground nutmeg
½ cup butter, softened
1 cup Wonderful Pistachios Sweet Cinnamon No Shells
½ cup pistachio nut butter
2 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup sugar
⅓ cup brown sugar
2 large eggs
3 cups flour
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp kosher salt
 
Cinnamon Sugar Mix: 
¼ cup sugar
1 tsp ground cinnamon
¼ tsp ground nutmeg
 
Directions:
In a small bowl, mix the cinnamon sugar topping and set aside.
In a large bowl, beat the butter and vanilla until light and fluffy. Add the sugar, brown sugar, and chopped Wonderful Pistachios Sweet Cinnamon; mix to combine.
Add the eggs and mix until smooth.
Sift in the flour, spices, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Stir until just combined. Cover and chill the dough.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll dough into ping-pong-sized balls, then coat each in the cinnamon sugar mixture.
Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake 10–12 minutes.
(Optional) Top with frosting and extra chopped pistachios once cooled.

column2: Strawberry-Cucumber Cooler Mocktail | Talenti Recipes
column3:
Talenti Strawberry-Cucumber Cooler Mocktail

Ingredients:
1⁄4 cup strawberries
1⁄2 mini cucumber, roughly chopped
1 box Talenti Summer Strawberry Mini Sorbetto Bars
1⁄2 cup coconut water
1⁄4 ounce agave
Cucumber slice, for garnish

Directions:
1. In a high-speed blender, combine strawberries, cucumber, coconut water and agave.
2. Blend on high speed until smooth. 
3. Strain into a glass filled with ice. 
4. Add 1 Talenti Summer Strawberry Mini Sorbetto Bar to glass. 
5. Garnish with a cucumber slice.

column2: Pomegranate Ginger-Lemon Mocktail | Talenti Recipes
column3:
Talenti Pomegranate Ginger-Lemon Mocktail Recipe

Ingredients:
4 ounces pomegranate juice
½ ginger-honey syrup *see below
1 box (6 mini bars) Talenti Zesty Lemon Mini Sorbetto Bars
Lemon slice or, for garnish

Directions:
1. In a cocktail shaker, add pomegranate juice, honey syrup and ice. Shake vigorously.
2. Strain mixture into glass filled with ice. 
3. Garnish with 1 Talenti Zesty Lemon Mini Sorbetto Bar. 
4. Garnish with lemon slice.
*Ginger-Honey Syrup: In a small saucepan over medium-heat, bring ½ cup water, ½ cup honey and ¼ inch piece of sliced ginger to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes or until mixture has thickened.

Juice of ½ lime

Habanero pepper, for garnish

Directions:
1. In a cocktail shaker, combine peach juice, habanero-agave syrup and ice. Shake

2. Strain mixture into glass filled with ice. 
3. Add 1 Talenti Alphonso Mango Mini Sorbetto Bar to glass. 
4. Garnish with a habanero pepper.
*Habanero-Agave Syrup: In a small saucepan over medium-heat, bring ½ cup water, ½
cup agave, 2 thin slices of habanero and ¼-inch piece of sliced ginger to a boil. Reduce
heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes or until mixture has thickened.

column2: Freshly 3-Minute Meal: Chicken Livorno

On top, we add our juicy, oven-roasted chicken breast, covered in a marinade of fragrant herbs. To bring out the meal’s rich, nutty flavors, our chefs recommend sprinkling the whole thing with shredded Parmesan. Turning up the heat isn’t a bad idea either—we love it with a shake of red pepper flakes or classic Frank’s hot sauce.

Loaded Tabletop Nachos with TABASCO® Salsa Picante

Big game. Big bites. Zero plates needed. Whether you’re yelling at the TV or guarding the nacho table TABASCO® Salsa Picante brings the heat to every game day.

Recipe Details:
• Prep Time: 15 minutes 
• Cook Time: 15 minutes 
• Total Time: 30 minutes 
• Servings: 4 people 
• Difficulty: Easy 
• Spicy Level: Medium

Nutrition (per serving, approximate)
• Calories: ~1,000 kcal 
• Protein: ~40 g 
• Carbohydrates: ~70 g 
• Fat: ~58 g 

 Ingredients:
• 1 lb ground beef 
• 1 teaspoon salt 
• ½ teaspoon black pepper 
• 1 teaspoon ground cumin 
• 1 teaspoon chili powder 
• ½ teaspoon paprika 
• 1 (15 oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed 
• 1 large bag tortilla chips 
Cheese Sauce
• ½ cup milk or heavy cream 
• 2 cups shredded cheese (cheddar, Monterey Jack, or blend) 
• TABASCO® Salsa Picante to taste 

Toppings:
• 1 cup pico de gallo 
• ½ cup sour cream 
• 1 cup shredded lettuce 
• ½ cup guacamole 
• ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped 
• Finish: TABASCO® Salsa Picante, to taste 

 Instructions:
• Season and cook ground beef in a pan on medium-high heat until cooked through and browned. 
• Heat black beans in a pot until warm. 
• Prepare the cheese sauce in a pot over medium heat. Add milk to pot. Once warm, slowly add cheese and continually stir until melted and blended. Once melted, add TABASCO® Salsa Picante to spice level preference. Stir until combined. 
• Next, cover countertop or tabletop in tin foil and assemble a layer of tortilla chips. Layer ingredients in the following order: ground beef, pico de gallo, cheese sauce, cilantro, shredded lettuce, sour cream, and guacamole. 
• Finish with TABASCO® Salsa Picante to taste.

Crispy Chicken Taquitos and Queso Spiced with TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce

Recipe Details: 
Prep Time: 25 minutes 
Cook Time: 60 minutes 
Total Time: 1 hour 25 minutes 
Servings: 8–10 people 

Nutrition (per serving, approximate) (Based on 10 servings; includes taquitos + TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce pico queso) 

Ingredients: 
Chicken Taquitos: 
1.5 lb chicken breast 
½ cup TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce 
1 cup chicken stock 
3 cloves garlic, minced 
1 teaspoon smoked paprika 
½ teaspoon ground cumin 
Salt, to taste 
1 tablespoon honey 
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese 
2 tablespoons cream cheese 
Street-size corn tortillas (20-24) 
Vegetable or canola oil, for frying 

Pico: 
3 Roma tomatoes, finely diced, seeds removed 
½ small white onion, finely diced 
3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, finely chopped 
Juice of 1 lime 
½ teaspoon salt 

Queso: 
1 (12-oz) can evaporated milk 
1 pound white American cheese, cut into ½-inch cubes 
¾ cup prepared pico de gallo 
1–2 teaspoons TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce 
Kosher salt and black pepper, to taste 

Garnishes: 
Fresh cilantro 
Lime wedges 
Mexican crema 
Additional TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce to taste 

Taquitos: 
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, paprika, and cumin. Heat EVOO in a medium sized pot and add the chicken once the oil shimmers. Sear on both sides, just looking for color, then remove. Add the garlic in the same pot, cook until fragrant. Deglaze with chicken stock, add the TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce and honey and bring to a simmer. Add the chicken back to the pot. Cover and cook until the chicken is tender and cooked through, about 15–18 minutes. Remove the chicken from the liquid and reduce the cooking liquid down. Shred the chicken, add cream cheese, shredded cheese and the reduced cooking liquid (about ⅓-½ cup). Mix until well combined. 
  
Warm the corn tortillas until pliable by heating them briefly in a dry skillet or wrapping them in a damp towel and microwaving for 30–45 seconds. Place a small line of the chicken filling across the lower third of each tortilla and roll tightly, seam-side down. Heat about 1 inch of oil in a heavy skillet to 350°F and fry the taquitos in batches, starting seam-side down, until golden brown and crisp on all sides, about 2–3 minutes per batch. Transfer to a wire rack. 
 
Queso: 
Combine the tomatoes, onion, cilantro, lime juice, and salt in a bowl and set aside to allow the flavors to meld. Add the evaporated milk to a saucepan and bring it to a gentle low simmer over medium-low heat, making sure it does not boil. Add the diced American cheese one small handful at a time, whisking continuously and aggressively after each addition until fully melted before adding more. Once all the cheese is incorporated and the queso is smooth and glossy, stir in the pico de gallo and TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce. Season lightly with salt and black pepper and keep warm over very low heat, stirring occasionally to maintain a silky consistency. Arrange the hot taquitos on a platter and garnish with cilantro, Mexican crema, cotija, TABASCO® Sriracha Sauce and a squeeze of lime. Serve immediately with the warm queso on the side. 
 
Dietary Notes: 
Contains: Dairy (milk, cheese, cream cheese, Mexican crema) 
Does NOT contain: Gluten, Alcohol, Eggs, Nuts (peanuts or tree nuts) 

Suitable for: Gluten-free diets (when prepared with certified gluten-free corn tortillas), Nut-free diets, Egg-free diets

column2: Scrambled Egg Breakfast Avocado Recipe - TAVO
column3:
Power up your morning with a scrambled egg loaded avocado. Learn more at https://www.tabasco.com/recipe/breakfast-tavo/.

INGREDIENTS

1-2 tablespoons TABASCO® Original Red Sauce
4 large eggs
Salt, taste
4 slices bacon
1 tablespoon bacon fat
1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
2 Avocados from Mexico
Chopped chives, for garnish

INSTRUCTIONS

In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, TABASCO® Original Red Sauce, and salt. Set aside.
Place bacon in a single layer on a large non stick pan.
Cook over medium heat until the bacon is crispy.
Remove bacon from pan and crumble.
Drain fat from pan, but reserve 1 tablespoon of the bacon fat. Set aside.
Heat the same pan over medium-low heat, once hot, add in bacon fat.
Pour in whisked eggs and cook until the eggs are scrambled to your liking.
Once cooked, stir in cheese and crumbled bacon (reserve some for garnish, if desired).
Taste and re-season, if necessary. Set aside.
Cut each avocado in half and remove the pit.
Using a teaspoon, remove some of the avocado, making room for the egg filling. See video for visual.
Sprinkle with salt.
Fill the avocados evenly with the egg mixture.
Top with chives and reserved bacon.
Enjoy!

column2: Crispy Baked Wings Recipe
column3:
Make your favorite restaurant-style wings at home with our Crispy Baked Wings Recipe! Get more easy and delicious wing sauce recipes at www.tabasco.com/wings.

INGREDIENTS
2 Tbsp. Baking powder
1/2 Tbsp. Salt
1 tsp. Paprika
1/4 tsp. Black pepper
12 lb. Chicken wings, drums and flats separated, tips removed

PREPARATION
Preheat oven to 425ºF.

Combine baking powder, salt, paprika and black pepper. Shake over both sides of the wings.

Place seasoned wings onto a rack over a foil lined sheet pan. Place in oven.

After 20 minutes, turn wings over and place back into the oven. Continue cooking for an additional 20 minutes if convection or 35 minutes if conventional oven. Cooked wings should be at least 180ºF internal temperature and crispy.

Remove from oven, toss with desired sauce and serve.

column2: 7 Layer Dip Recipe
column3:
Learn more at https://www.tabasco.com/recipe/7-layer-dip/.

INGREDIENTS

SPICY GUACAMOLE
2 tablespoons TABASCO® Original Red Sauce
1/4 cup freshly squeezed lime juice
4 Avocados from Mexico
1/2 small white onion, finely diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup cilantro, chopped
1/2 teaspoon salt, plus more to taste

SPICY BEANS
2 tablespoons TABASCO® Original Red Sauce
1 (16 oz) can refried beans

7 LAYER CUPS
8 (9 oz) clear plastic cups
1 batch spicy guacamole, recipe above
1 batch spicy beans, recipe above
1 (16 oz) tub sour cream
1 (16 oz) jar thick & chunky salsa, drained through a fine mesh sieve
16 tablespoons shredded cheddar cheese
1 (10 oz) container grape tomatoes, halved
1 bunch green onions, sliced
1 (2.25 oz) can sliced black olives
Tortilla chips, for serving

INSTRUCTIONS

SPICY GUACAMOLE
Pour TABASCO® Sauce and lime juice into a medium sized bowl.
Halve and pit each avocado, then scoop out the flesh and place into the bowl.
Using a hand mixer, fork, or potato masher, mash the avocados until desired texture is reached. See video for visual.
Stir in onion, garlic, cilantro, and salt.
Taste and re-season, if necessary. Set aside.

SPICY BEANS
Mix together beans and TABASCO® Sauce in a medium sized bowl. Set aside.

7 LAYER CUPS
Place 2 tablespoons spicy bean mixture into the bottom of each plastic cup.
Top with 3 tablespoons spicy guacamole.
Top with 2 tablespoons sour cream.
Top with 2 tablespoons salsa.
Top with 2 tablespoons shredded cheese.
Top with tomatoes.
Top with olives and green onions.

Serve with tortilla chips and enjoy!

column2: Is Huel Actually Good for You?
column3:
Here's a summary of what we found 👇

Participants:
⬇️ Decreased BMI
⬇️ Waist circumference
⬇️ and visceral adipose tissue (fat around organs)

⬆️ increased their vitamin D, B12, iron and selenium levels (important for things like muscle function, metabolism, reducing tiredness and fatigue and supporting the immune system)

And all other nutrients remained within normal levels! (so if you were wondering if those vitamins were actually absorbed, now you know!)

🩸 Improved blood glucose markers
👍 Improved total, and non-HDL cholesterol (often called "bad" cholesterol)

❓"I thought Huel wasn't meant for 100% usage?"

🅰️ Correct, Huel is food for your most inconvenient meal. But 100% Huel made this research as controlled as possible.

❓"Huel obviously funded this study, so therefore it must be biased."

🅰️ We did provide funding for this study. If we didn't it is unlikely anyone would research Huel specifically. But rejecting research for this reason is bad science. You should be aware of this of course, but if we rejected all industry-funded science there wouldn't be a lot of science left. Critique the methods, not just the funding.

❓ "Some of the participants ate fewer calories than they were meant to. Why?"

🅰️ True, some participants self-selected to be in calorie deficit and as a result lost weight. So more research is needed to establish the effect of Huel vs the effects of just losing weight.

We are committed to making sure Huel is the best product it can be ✌️ This is a start, and we are excited to do more research at a larger scale 🙌

If you have questions about this study then please ask below and we will answer as many as we can!

If you want to read *even* more, you can hit the link in our bio. Or you can read the full paper for free online, just Google 'Huel Frontiers'.

column2: Viral Japanese Cheesecake
column3:
POV: You started romanticizing your protein-packed breakfast.

Using our secret protein potion — aka Kodiak Cookie Butter Crunchy Bars — to turn this recipe into your forever breakfast crush.

Ingredients:
* 2 Kodiak Cookie Butter Crunchy Bars
* 1 tbsp instant coffee
* ½ cup greek yogurt
* 1 tsp maple syrup
* 1 tbsp cookie butter

Directions:
1. In a small bowl, mix together the instant coffee, Greek yogurt, and maple syrup until smooth. Set aside.
2. Remove one Kodiak Cookie Butter Crunchy Bar from the package and crumble it into the bottom of a small dish.
3. Spoon the coffee yogurt mixture over the crumble and smooth evenly.
4. Break the second crunchy bar into four equal pieces and gently press them into the yogurt until fully covered.
5. Microwave the cookie butter for 20–30 seconds, or until melted and pourable. Drizzle evenly over the top.
6. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to set.
7. Enjoy.

column2: Soylent x Swipe Out Hunger
column3:
There have been college students who have struggled to balance paying for tuition, housing, and meals for decades, but the problem is getting worse and quickly.  In 2018 this issue hit the Soylent radar, through research conducted by Dr. Sara Goldrick- Rab. The data in this report (the largest study of its kind) showed that 36% of university students and 42% of community college students were food insecure.  This is staggering and got our attention.  This is different than being a college student who skipped breakfast and finds their stomach growling in the library. Food insecurity is about the lack of resources to fill your physical hunger.  This is a much deeper and more systemic problem.  


Swipe Out Hunger is our lead non-profit partner and they are working on democratizing dining hall meals on 82 campuses across the country.  We are also financially supporting the research and work of Dr. Goldrick-Rab and The Hope Center, and are lead sponsors of their #RealCollege convening.

column2: Dijon​ ​and​ ​Herb​ ​Chicken​ ​Breasts​ ​with​ ​Roasted​ ​Carrots​ ​and​ ​Farro
column3:
Find more Sir Kensington's Recipe ideas on our Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/sirkensingtons/

Dijon​ ​and​ ​Herb​ ​Chicken​ ​Breasts​ ​with​ ​Roasted​ ​Carrots​ ​and​ ​Farro

Serves: 2
Preparation time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
For the chicken-
2 bone-in skin-on chicken breasts
Salt and pepper
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 tablespoons Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Dijon​ ​Mustard
1 tablespoon thyme, leaves removed from stem
1 tablespoon chopped rosemary
1 teaspoon lemon zest
Juice of half a lemon
Salt and pepper, as needed
For the sides-
1⁄2 lb carrots (about 4 medium, 6 small), peeled and cut into even-sized chunks
1 tablespoon chopped rosemary
1 cup farro, rinsed
Olive oil, for drizzling
Salt and pepper, to taste

Directions:
For the chicken-
1. Preheat the oven to 425°F.
2. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper
3. In a small bowl, combine the olive oil, Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Dijon​ ​Mustard​, thyme,
rosemary, lemon zest and juice.
4. Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish and top each one with the Dijon mixture.
5. Roast the chicken breasts for 30-35 minutes, or until cooked through, the juices run
clear, with an internal temperature of at least 165°F.
6. Serve alongside the roasted carrots and farro.
For the sides-
1. For the carrots- Toss the carrots with olive oil, chopped rosemary, and salt and pepper.
Transfer to a baking sheet and roast along with the chicken until golden brown and
tender, about 25-30 minutes.
2. For the farro- Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the rinsed farro to the pot. Boil until
the farro is tender and al dente, or according to the package instructions. Drain. Drizzle
with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

column2: Sir Kensington's Uncommonly Good Marinade
column3:
In his years as a spice trader, Sir Kensington's traveled the world tasting some of the world's most delicious food. In this marinade he combines some of his favorite flavors to make an uncommonly delicious marinade perfect for chicken!

Soy​ ​Ketchup​ ​Garlic​ ​Chicken

Serves: 4
Preparation time: 45 minutes

Ingredients:
2-3 lbs bone-in skin-on chicken legs, or just thighs
1⁄2​ ​cup​ ​Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Classic​ ​Ketchup
1⁄3 cup soy sauce
2 tablespoons brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced fine
Salt and pepper
Directions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and arrange in a baking dish.
3. In a bowl combine Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Classic​ ​Ketchup​, soy sauce brown sugar, and
garlic.
4. Pour the marinade over the chicken.
5. Bake until caramelized and cooked through, about 45 minutes.

Ingredients:
4 oz cubed pancetta
1 lb brussels sprouts, halved
3 tablespoons olive oil
2⁄3 cup chicken or vegetable broth
1 tablespoon butter
2 cloves garlic, minced fine
2 tablespoons Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Spicy​ ​Brown​ ​Mustard
1 tablespoon honey
2 teaspoons red wine vinegar
Salt and pepper, as needed

Directions:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook the pancetta until crispy and the fat is rendered.
Remove the pancetta from the pan and reserve.
2. To the same pan with the pancetta drippings, add the brussels sprouts and sauté until
starting to brown, 5-6 minutes.
3. Add the chicken broth to the pan cover the pan, reduce the heat and allow the brussels
sprouts to cook until tender and the broth is mostly evaporated, about 8-10 minutes.
4. Once the brussels are fork tender, transfer them to the serving dish.
5. To the same pan add the butter and garlic, and sauté until the garlic is fragrant but not
yet browned, about 1-2 minutes. Transfer the butter and garlic to a small bowl.
6. To the butter and garlic, add Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Spicy​ ​Brown​ ​Mustard​, honey, and red
wine vinegar. Taste for seasoning.
7. Add the cooked pancetta to the brussels sprouts, and pour the sauce over the dish. Toss
everything together until well coated in the mustard sauce.
8. Serve warm or at room temperature.

column2: Special Sauce Crusted Salmon with Roasted Asparagus and Potatoes
column3:
We're hooked on this easy and delicious weeknight meal!

​Special​ ​Sauce​ ​Crusted​ ​Salmon​ ​with​ ​Roasted​ ​Asparagus​ ​and
Potatoes

Serves: 4
Preparation time: 30 minutes

Ingredients:
1 lb baby or fingerling potatoes, cleaned halved
Olive oil, for drizzling
4 (6 oz) salmon filets
1⁄4 cup Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Special​ ​Sauce
1⁄2 cup panko breadcrumbs
1 bunch asparagus, trimmed
Salt and pepper, as needed
Juice of 1⁄2 a lemon

Directions:
1. Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a bowl, toss the halved potatoes with a generous drizzle of olive oil and season with
salt and pepper. Place the halved potatoes onto the baking sheet. Roast for 15-20
minutes, or until just starting to crisp.
3. While the potatoes are cooking, prepare the salmon. Season the salmon lightly with salt
and pepper. Spread Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Special​ ​Sauce​ ​evenly on each of the 4 filets. Top
the salmon fillets with panko.
4. In the same bowl as the potatoes, toss the asparagus with some olive oil and season
with salt and pepper.
5. Remove the sheet pan with the potatoes from the oven and nestle the salmon and the
asparagus onto the pan.
6. Bake for an additional 8-10 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through and the
asparagus is bright green.
7. Remove from the oven and squeeze lemon juice over the salmon and vegetables.
8. Serve with extra Sir Kensington’s Special Sauce!

column2: Smoky Pimento Cheese Dip
column3:
Sir Kensington's Chipotle Mayo adds an irresistible smoky heat to this classic entertaining recipe.

Chipotle​ ​Pimento​ ​Dip
Serves: 8
Preparation time: 5 minutes

Ingredients:
4 oz cream cheese, at room temperature
½ cup Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Chipotle​ ​Mayonnaise
1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce
½ teaspoon sugar
8 oz shredded sharp cheddar
8 oz shredded Colby Jack cheese
1 4 oz jar diced pimentos, drained
Salt and pepper, to taste

Directions:
1. With an electric hand mixer, combine the cream cheese, Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Chipotle
Mayonnaise,​ ​Worcestershire, and sugar until creamy and smooth.
2. Add the shredded cheddar and Colby Jack cheese, and stir until well combined
3. Fold in the sliced pimentos.
4. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.
5. Serve alongside crackers or crudités.

column2: Mexican-Style Street Corn (Elotes) with Avocado Crema
column3:
Check us out on Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/sirkensingtons

Elotes​ ​with​ ​Avocado​ ​Crema
Serves: 4
Preparation time: 20 minutes

Ingredients:
1 avocado
¼ cup​ ​Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Avocado​ ​Mayonnaise
2 tablespoons Mexican crema or sour cream
Juice of 1 lime
½ teaspoon chili powder
4 ears corn
½ cup Cotija cheese, crumbled
2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
Lime wedges

Directions:
1. Add the avocado to a bowl, and mash well with a fork.
2. To the avocado add​ ​Sir​ ​Kensington’s​ ​Avocado​ ​Mayonnaise​, Mexican crema, lime
juice, and chili powder. Combine until smooth and creamy.
3. On a hot grill, or on a hot grill pan, grill the corn until tender and charred, about 10-15
minutes.
4. Evenly coat the cooked corn with the avocado crema. Top with crumbled Cotija cheese
and chopped cilantro.
5. Serve with fresh lime wedges

Fiber-Rich Chocolate-Covered Berries
-1 cup chopped dark chocolate
-1/2 scoop Fiber Super Powder
-assortment of fresh berries

If tempering the chocolate (slightly more challenging):
Melt 2/3 of chopped dark chocolate over a double boiler.
Remove bowl from heat.
Stir in remaining 1/3 chocolate until cooled to 88-90°F.
Let cool at room temperature. This will give the chocolate a professional “snap.”

If you prefer not to temper (slightly easier):
Melt chopped dark chocolate over a double boiler until almost all is melted.
Remove bowl from heat, and continue stirring until all pieces are melted. Let cool at room temperature, or for a “snap” or to faster cool, place bowl in the fridge.

Once chocolate is melted and fully cooled:
Stir in 1/2 scoop of Fiber Super powder until well combined and fully dissolved.
Ensure your berries are completely dry (this is very important if you want the chocolate to stick!) and dip into chocolate. Tap off excess, and place on parchment paper to set.
Optional: Sprinkle sumac on before the chocolate cools.

(And quite cozy for our fellow New Yorkers bracing for a blizzard). With fiber-rich beans and greens, and naturally detoxifying garlic and lemon, it’s one you’ll want in your regular rotation.

Fiber-Forward Detox Soup
-1 lb dried cannellini beans, soaked overnight and drained
-Olive oil
-1 large shallot, peeled and halved
-2 leeks, chopped and well-washed
-1 small head garlic, top sliced off 
-1-inch piece fresh ginger, chopped 
-1/2 lemon
-Pinch red pepper flakes
-6–8 cups water or vegetable broth
-1 small Parmesan rind (optional)
-1 bunch parsley
-1 bunch of kale 
-Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste

Heat a generous drizzle of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leeks and a pinch of salt and sauté for 2–3 minutes, until just softened. 
Add the shallot halves, garlic head (cut-side down), and lemon half (cut-side down). Cook until lightly charred and fragrant, about 3–4 minutes. Add the ginger and red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds more.
Add the drained beans, parsley bundle, Parmesan rind (if using), and 6–8 cups water or broth (beans should be covered by about 2 inches). Bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 1½–2 hours, stirring occasionally, until beans are very tender and the broth is flavorful. Add more water as needed to keep beans submerged.

Remove and discard the parsley, lemon, and Parmesan rind. Squeeze the softened garlic cloves out of their skins into the soup and stir to incorporate. Stir in chopped kale and simmer just until wilted, about 2–3 minutes.
Season generously with pepper, fresh dill & parsley. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and extra lemon juice if desired.
